driverHome.scheduledRidesPerDriver: G3-R3 (owner 2026-10-30 'Remove the switch'): the admin's per-driver 'Scheduled driver access' switch is removed; every driver can take booked rides (the zone's reservations.on still decides). No server path ever set Driver.scheduledRides; the field (owner decision 2, v0.4.2) stays in the schema for older apps and is never sent; apps ignore it.

ridersOnline.note: G3-R4 (owner 'Real numbers only'): riders online per zone = distinct riders who in the last windowSeconds called GET /rider/nearby-vehicles (the open rider map) or POST /quotes (zone of the map point / pickup), plus riders with an open request (trip requested, searching or offered) in that zone. Served on GET /admin/live/drivers as LiveDriverList.ridersOnline [{ zoneId, count }] (the admin's zones only, zones with 0 included) — the admin Dashboard's 'Riders online' shows it; no invented numbers.

performance.note: G3-D2 (owner 2026-10-30, 'Real numbers'). The server computes the driver's own numbers over the last windowDays days (rolling, server clock) and sends them as Driver.performance on GET /driver/profile (the driver himself) and GET /admin/drivers/{driverId} (admin). Same counts as the dispatch score inputs (CONTRACT.md §3.6 factors acceptance and cancel): offersAnswerable = the driver's offers of kind exclusive or assigned sent in the window that ended claimed, declined or expired (withdrawn and claimed_elsewhere are not counted: he could not answer them); offersAccepted = those claimed; acceptancePct = round(offersAccepted / offersAnswerable × 100); tripsCancelled = the driver's cancels after accepting (driver_cancels) in the window; cancellationPct = round(min(100, tripsCancelled / offersAccepted × 100)). acceptancePct is null while offersAnswerable < minOffers; cancellationPct is null while offersAccepted < minTrips. rating = the average of the riders' visible ratings (hidden ratings not counted, 2 decimals), null while ratingCount < minRatings. The app shows '—' for null (sv/fr/en: same dash). Dispatch (§3.6) uses these same counts unrounded as soon as there is any data (the minimums only decide what the apps show); with no data at all it uses the §3.6 defaults (rating 4.7, acceptance 85 %, cancels 5 %).

nearbyBlur.note: G3-D4 (owner 2026-10-30, 'Slightly moved'). GET /rider/nearby-vehicles never gives a driver's exact position: each car is moved by an offset of minMeters..maxMeters in a direction, both taken from an HMAC of the driver id and the time slot of stableMinutes (server clock), so a car does not jump between answers inside a slot; the offset changes at the next slot. The answer still carries no identity (opaque key, contract.json#riderNearby). The exact position is shown only to the rider of a trip a driver accepted, through the existing trip views (TripProjection driver location).

zoneSupply.note: G3-D5 (owner 2026-10-30, 'Fix it'). LiveDriverList.zoneSupply on GET /admin/live/drivers: one row per zone of the answer, the Dashboard's supply/demand rows AND its shortage alert use these same numbers. Every driver online or on_trip counts in his zone (LiveDriver.zoneId: the zone of his latest position, else his first own zone), stale position included. online = those drivers; free = online drivers with onlineStatus online and no active trip; busy = online − free; waiting = trips of the zone in status requested, searching or offered with no driver yet (live rides only, not reservations before their search starts). level: ok when waiting = 0; tight when 0 < waiting <= free; short when waiting > free. shortage = level short. The panel shows the shortage alert only when at least one row has shortage true and names those rows.

legal.note: v0.18.5 (owner G1-B2 "Real texts from admin (Recommended)"): the terms of use and the privacy policy per country (SE, FR) in sv / fr / en, edited by the admin (Content › Legal, the content place legal), versioned, shown in both apps (also before sign-in) and accepted again when a new version asks for it. The built-in texts are Movera-made drafts: a lawyer must review them before launch.
legal.lawyerReview: Drafts (version 0) say so on their first line. A lawyer reviews the texts before launch; the admin publishes the reviewed ones.
legal.company: LegalCompany { companyName?, orgNumber?, address?, supportEmail?, supportPhone? }, filled by the admin. In the texts a placeholder {companyName} … is replaced by the admin's value; a paragraph whose placeholder has no value is left out, so nothing empty or made up is shown.
legal.read: GET /legal/{country} (no token, auth.beforeSignIn.allowed) → LegalTexts { country, version, source: default | admin, publishedAt?, reaccept, reacceptFrom, terms: LegalDocument { title, text } , privacy: LegalDocument } with title and text in sv / fr / en and the placeholders already filled. version 0 = the built-in drafts (nothing published). Unknown country: 404 not_found (reason legal_country_unknown). Apps read it on start and when they come back to the foreground (no stream event), and keep the last answer offline. reacceptFrom = the newest version published with reaccept true (null when none was): the version a person must have accepted (or a later one). v0.18.8: ?zoneId= (optional) fills {waitingRules} with that zone's live waiting, no-show and cancel numbers (contract.json#arrivedWaiting.termsTexts).
legal.admin: GET /admin/legal/{country} (settings.read) → LegalAdminView { live: LegalVersion (raw texts with placeholders and company), history: LegalVersion[] newest first }; POST /admin/legal/{country}/publish { terms: { title, text }, privacy: { title, text }, company?, reaccept? } (settings.publish, audited legal.publish) → LegalVersion with version + 1; every title and text needs sv, fr and en (text up to 20000 characters). An admin with a zone in that country, or a Super admin, may edit it.
legal.accept: POST /account/legal/accept { country, version } (rider, driver) → 204; version must be the live one (409 conflict, reason terms_version_not_current). Who must accept: the newest version published with reaccept true (LegalTexts.reacceptFrom) is the one that counts; accepting it or any later version satisfies it (accepting v3 also satisfies v2), and a later publish without reaccept never unblocks a person who did not accept it. Until then the rider cannot book (POST /trips 409 conflict, reason terms_not_accepted) and the driver cannot go online (POST /driver/availability 409 invalid_transition, reason terms_not_accepted); a person counts for the countries of his zones (rider: the pickup zone; driver: his zones and his latest position's zone). Version 0 needs no accept (accepted at sign-up).
legal.apps: Both apps show 'Terms' and 'Privacy' as two separate links on the sign-in screen and in the menu, read from GET /legal/{country} of the start country (auth.startCountry), else of the account's country. When reacceptFrom is not null and the person has not accepted a version >= reacceptFrom (it then accepts the live version), the next app start (never during a trip) shows the new terms with 'Jag godkänner' / 'J'accepte' / 'I accept'.
legal.legacyContent: The zone content item legal (§19) stays readable for older apps; new apps use GET /legal/{country}.

text.sv:
Utkast – granskas av jurist före lansering.

1. Tjänsten. Movera förmedlar resor mellan resenärer och förare med taxitrafiktillstånd i Sverige. Resan utförs av föraren och dess åkeri.

2. Konto. Du registrerar dig med ditt mobilnummer och ansvarar för att uppgifterna är riktiga. Du måste vara minst 18 år.

3. Pris och betalning. Priset visas innan du bokar. Avgifter för avbokning, väntetid och extra stopp följer reglerna som visas i appen. Betalning sker med de sätt som erbjuds i din zon.

3.1 Väntetid vid upphämtning. När föraren har kommit fram är de första minuternas väntan gratis. Därefter läggs varje minuts väntan till priset, räknat per sekund. Väntepengarna går till föraren.

3.2 Utebliven kund. Om du inte har kommit till bilen när den fria väntetiden är slut får föraren avsluta resan som utebliven kund och en avgift för utebliven kund tas ut. Avbokar du efter att föraren kommit fram och den fria väntetiden är slut räknas det som utebliven kund där områdets regler säger så.

3.3 Avbokning. Du kan avboka gratis de första minuterna efter att en förare har accepterat (en bokad resa: fram till tiden som visas före upphämtningen). Därefter kan en avbokningsavgift tas ut, bara om föraren verkligen var på väg.

3.4 Särskilda upphämtningar. Annan fri väntetid kan gälla på flygplatser, vid evenemang, för bokade resor och när föraren kommer långt ifrån; vid stopp under resan kan några fria minuter gälla innan väntan kostar. Resan visar vilka regler den följer, och det är de siffrorna den debiteras efter.

3.5 Reglerna i ditt område just nu:
{waitingRules}

4. Uppträdande. Var vänlig och säker. Våld, hot, diskriminering och skadegörelse leder till att kontot stängs.

5. Säkerhet. Vid fara: ring 112. SOS-knappen under resan larmar också Movera.

6. Förare. Förare måste ha giltiga dokument (körkort, taxiförarlegitimation, fordon med taxitrafiktillstånd och försäkring) och följa svensk lag.

7. Ansvar. Movera ansvarar för förmedlingen. För själva resan gäller lagen om taxitrafik och åkeriets ansvar.

8. Ändringar. Vi kan ändra villkoren. Vid viktiga ändringar ber appen dig godkänna de nya villkoren.

9. Lag och tvist. Svensk lag gäller. Du kan vända dig till Allmänna reklamationsnämnden (ARN) som konsument.

Adress: {address}.

E-post: {supportEmail}.

Telefon: {supportPhone}.
text.fr:
Projet – à relire par un avocat avant le lancement.

1. Le service. Movera met en relation passagers et chauffeurs titulaires d’une autorisation de taxi en Suède. La course est réalisée par le chauffeur et sa société.

2. Compte. Vous vous inscrivez avec votre numéro de mobile et vos informations doivent être exactes. Vous devez avoir au moins 18 ans.

3. Prix et paiement. Le prix est affiché avant la réservation. Les frais d’annulation, d’attente et d’arrêts suivent les règles affichées dans l’application.

3.1 Attente à la prise en charge. Quand le chauffeur est arrivé, les premières minutes d’attente sont gratuites. Ensuite, chaque minute d’attente s’ajoute au prix, comptée à la seconde. L’argent de l’attente revient au chauffeur.

3.2 Client absent. Si vous n’êtes pas venu à la voiture à la fin de l’attente gratuite, le chauffeur peut clôturer la course pour absence et des frais de client absent sont facturés. Annuler après l’arrivée du chauffeur et la fin de l’attente gratuite compte comme une absence lorsque les règles de la zone le prévoient.

3.3 Annulation. Vous pouvez annuler gratuitement pendant les premières minutes après l’acceptation d’un chauffeur (course réservée : jusqu’à l’heure indiquée avant la prise en charge). Ensuite, des frais d’annulation peuvent s’appliquer, seulement si le chauffeur était vraiment en route.

3.4 Prises en charge particulières. Une autre attente gratuite peut s’appliquer dans les aéroports, lors d’événements, pour les courses réservées et quand le chauffeur vient de loin ; aux arrêts pendant la course, quelques minutes gratuites peuvent s’appliquer avant que l’attente soit facturée. La course affiche les règles qu’elle suit, et ce sont ces chiffres qui sont facturés.

3.5 Les règles de votre zone en ce moment :
{waitingRules}

4. Comportement. Restez courtois et prudent. Violence, menaces, discrimination ou dégradations entraînent la fermeture du compte.

5. Sécurité. En cas de danger : appelez le 112. Le bouton SOS pendant la course alerte aussi Movera.

6. Chauffeurs. Les chauffeurs doivent avoir des documents valides (permis, carte de chauffeur de taxi, véhicule autorisé et assuré) et respecter la loi suédoise.

7. Responsabilité. Movera est responsable de la mise en relation. La course relève de la loi suédoise sur le taxi et de la société de transport.

8. Modifications. Nous pouvons modifier ces conditions. En cas de changement important, l’application vous demandera de les accepter.

9. Droit applicable. Le droit suédois s’applique. Les consommateurs peuvent saisir l’Allmänna reklamationsnämnden (ARN).

Movera est exploité par {companyName}.

Numéro d’immatriculation : {orgNumber}.

Adresse : {address}.

E-mail : {supportEmail}.

Téléphone : {supportPhone}.
text.en:
Draft – to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

1. The service. Movera connects riders with drivers who hold a taxi permit in Sweden. The ride is carried out by the driver and the driver's company.

2. Account. You sign up with your mobile number and must keep your details correct. You must be at least 18.

3. Price and payment. The price is shown before you book. Cancellation, waiting and extra-stop fees follow the rules shown in the app.

3.1 Waiting at pickup. When the driver has arrived, the first minutes of waiting are free. After that, every minute of waiting is added to the price, counted by the second. The waiting money goes to the driver.

3.2 No-show. If you have not come to the car when the free waiting is over, the driver may end the ride as a no-show and a no-show fee is charged. Cancelling after the driver arrived and the free waiting is over counts as a no-show where the area’s rules say so.

3.3 Cancelling. You can cancel for free during the first minutes after a driver accepted (a booked ride: until the time shown before pickup). After that a cancellation fee may be charged, only when the driver was really on the way.

{waitingRules}

8. Modifications. Nous pouvons modifier ces conditions. En cas de changement important, l’application vous demandera de les accepter.

9. Droit applicable. Le droit français s’applique. Les consommateurs peuvent saisir gratuitement un médiateur de la consommation.

driverOffers.note: v0.18.6 (owner decisions 1–7 of 2026-10-29 and answers G4-E1..E7 of 2026-10-30, driver group 4 'Incoming offer & exclusive offer', Rules decisions/driver-g4.md). Works the same in every country (SE and FR); every text in sv / fr / en.

push.note: Decision 1 + E6. For every new offer (feed event offer_created) the server also sends a push to the driver's registered fcm devices (auth.devices.sending: after the command commits, one retry, dead tokens removed), so a driver whose app is in the background or whose phone is locked hears and sees it. It is NOT a bell notice: it never appears in GET /notifications, is not counted unread and cannot be marked read (404). A push not handed to Firebase before the offer's expiresAt is dropped. Title and body in the driver's account language (else the zone's default). The app in the foreground ignores the push (the offer stream already shows the offer). A tap opens the app at data.deepLink: the offer card while the offer is still open, else Home.
push.rule: E6 (owner 'Sound + vibration'): Exclusive and hand-sent (assigned) offers play the Movera offer sound and vibrate (vibration only while the driver's own Vibrate setting in the app is on), in the foreground and in the push; Radar offers stay quiet (no sound, no vibration).

data.expiresAt: Offer.expiresAt (ISO time); the app shows nothing after it

native.note: Android: an offer with sound uses the notification channel androidChannel (sound file soundFile, vibration on, high importance); a quiet one androidQuietChannel (no sound, no vibration). iOS: aps.sound iosSound, none when quiet; interruption-level time-sensitive. Web: data-only message; the service worker shows it (silent when quiet; vibrate webVibratePattern when vibrate is 'true') and the open page plays the sound. The native apps add the sound file and the two channels when their store builds are made.

body.sv: Tryck för att se resan
body.fr: Appuyez pour voir la course
body.en: Tap to see the trip

riderRating.note: Decision 3 (owner 'Show it'): Offer.riderRating = the rider's average of the visible ratings drivers gave him (riders' own rating, as Rider.rating), rounded to 2 decimals; the card shows it with one decimal and a star. Shown by default. A rider with no rating yet gets NO riderRating (the card shows nothing; never a made-up value — the old 4.9 fallback idea is dropped). The admin turns it off per zone with DriverAppConfig.offers.offerCard.riderRating = false (Settings › Driver app › Offer card, per zone or the country standard): the server then sends no riderRating on offers of trips in that zone, and the app also hides it. The value is taken when the offer is sent and does not change on that offer.

acceptCheck.note: Decision 4 (owner 'Lock + Accepting… + check'). The app locks the Accept button at the first tap and shows texts.accepting. It sends POST /offers/{offerId}/accept with an Idempotency-Key. When the answer is lost (network error, no answer within answerTimeoutSeconds), it asks the server GET /driver/offers/{offerId} → OfferCheck { offer, trip? } (every checkEverySeconds, until checkForSeconds): offer.status claimed and trip present → open that trip (it is his); offer.status open and expiresAt not passed → send the SAME accept again with the SAME Idempotency-Key (the server answers the first result if it already ran); any other status (claimed_elsewhere, expired, withdrawn, declined) → texts.gone for 2 s on the island at the top of Home (decision 5; it is not a miss). Only the offer's own driver may read it (another driver's offer is 404 offer_not_found).

driverOffers.whyYouRemoved: E7 (owner 'Remove short line explain'): the 'why you got this trip' line is removed from the offer card. The server no longer sends Offer.reasonCode (deprecated, kept in the schema so older builds keep working: they show no line when it is missing) and DriverAppConfig.offers.exclusiveReasons is deprecated and ignored (apps never show it; the admin hides its Dispatch › Exclusive reasons editor). It was only used on the offer card.
driverOffers.declinedComesBack: E1 (owner 'Can come back later'): no change. An Exclusive offer the driver declined or missed may come back to him later as a Radar offer if nobody else took the trip.
driverOffers.notDecided: E5 (rider 'Keep waiting?' steps vs the rider app's own 3-minute card) is NOT decided (owner: ask again later); the rider-waiting steps are unchanged in v0.18.6.
driverOffers.declineAlways: v0.18.14 (live sweep M-4): POST /offers/{offerId}/decline never answers 409 for an older offer version (an Exclusive that turned into a Radar offer moved it); an offer that is no longer open answers 200 with the offer as it is now, so the card always closes.

dispatchTools.note: v0.18.6 (owner decisions G4-F1..F6 of 2026-10-31, Rules decisions/driver-g4.md, research plan/g4-admin-features.md): the admin's Dispatch tools, real on the server. Everything is per country (SE, FR): an admin reads and changes a country's items only with a zone of that country in scope (Super admin: all), else 403 zone_out_of_scope. Writes need dispatch.edit, reads trips.read; every write is audited (auditActions) and takes an Idempotency-Key. Each item has a version: PUT and DELETE need expectedVersion (409 version_mismatch with the item). Names: 1–40 characters, unique per country (409 conflict, reason name_taken).
dispatchTools.approvals: F1 (owner 'Live now, remove box'): dispatch changes (publishing the dispatch document, the zone's dispatch switch, presets, groups, radar zones, rules, events, sends) never wait for a second admin: the one-admin rule of 2026-10-28 (adminControlMatrix.oneAdmin) stays. The panel removes the 'Waiting for a second admin' box and badge; History + Undo stay. Dispatch approvals still pending from before that rule were expired by server migration 0040.

presets.note: F2 (owner 'Per country only'): saved Dispatch presets per country. values = a DispatchDocument without version, publishedAt, zoneId, country, timeZone and usesStandard (checked like the document; 400 invalid_document). Any admin with dispatch.edit may save, rename, change or delete one. Applying a preset is the panel's job: it copies values into the zone's dispatch draft (PUT /admin/config/dispatch) and publishes as usual.
presets.entity: DispatchPreset { presetId, country, name, values, version, createdBy?, createdAt, updatedBy?, updatedAt }

groups.note: F3 (owner 'Free ones, nearest first'): driver groups per country, admin only (drivers are never told). Every driver must be of the group's country (400 invalid_request, reason driver_not_in_country); at most 200 drivers. Send to a group: POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/radar-group { expectedVersion, groupId } — the server picks the group's FREE members (account active, online, not on a trip, a position newer than 120 s, the trip's category, no open offer for this trip), nearest to the pickup first, at most 10, and sends them a radar offer each (as a radar group). A member who is not free is skipped, never an error; 409 conflict, reason no_free_driver, only when no member is free. Reservations will use groups with group 15 (a group used by a reservation rule will then be 409 group_in_use on delete; nothing uses groups yet).
groups.entity: DriverGroup { groupId, country, name, driverIds, version, createdBy?, createdAt, updatedBy?, updatedAt }

radarZones.note: F4 (owner 'Repeat until taken'): radar zones (an area drawn inside one operating zone of the country; polygon as contract.json#zones.polygon, 3–500 points) and radar zone rules per country. A rule says which radar zones it is for ('all' or a list of radarZoneIds of its country), how long each send stays open (seconds 5–120), how many drivers at most (maxDrivers 1–10) and whether it sends again by itself (repeat). Manual admin sends only: automatic dispatch never uses radar zones. Send: POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/radar-group { expectedVersion, radarZoneId, ruleId } (the rule must cover the radar zone: 400 rule_not_for_zone) → radar offers to the free drivers (as for groups) whose latest position is inside the polygon, nearest to the pickup first, up to rule.maxDrivers, open rule.seconds. Without repeat: 409 no_free_driver when nobody is free inside. With repeat: when the offers run out and nobody accepted, the server sends again to whoever is free inside the area then (newcomers included; drivers who still hold an open offer of this trip are skipped), every rule.seconds, until a driver accepts, an admin stops it (POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/radar-zone/stop), the rider's search ends (8 min) or the trip ends; a round with nobody free inside waits for the next. A new radar-zone send on the same trip replaces the running one. GET /admin/dispatch/radar-zones/{radarZoneId}/free?categoryId= → { radarZoneId, free, at } counts the free drivers inside now. A radar zone used by a rule's list cannot be deleted (409 conflict, reason radar_zone_in_use).
entities: RadarZone { radarZoneId, country, zoneId, name, polygon, version, createdBy?, createdAt, updatedBy?, updatedAt }
RadarZoneRule { ruleId, country, name, radarZoneIds: 'all' | Id[], seconds, maxDrivers, repeat, version, createdBy?, createdAt, updatedBy?, updatedAt }
RadarZoneSend { sendId, tripId, radarZoneId, ruleId, seconds, maxDrivers, repeat, active, rounds, startedAt, stoppedAt?, stopReason?: admin | accepted | search_ended | trip_over | replaced }
routes: POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/radar-zone/stop { note? } → RadarZoneSend (404 radar_zone_send_not_found when none runs)
radarZones.sendView: Every admin sees a running send: GET /admin/trips/{tripId} carries TripProjection.radarZoneSend (RadarZoneSend: sendId, radarZoneId, ruleId, intervalSeconds, rounds, startedAt, active …) while it is active, and nothing once it ended. The send ends at once (not at the next interval) when a driver accepts (stopReason accepted), the trip is cancelled or ends (trip_over), the rider's search ends (search_ended), an admin stops it (admin) or a new radar-zone send replaces it (replaced).

events.note: F6 (owner 'small premium icon at the exact location of the event; tap → all details'): events per country made by the admin: name, the exact point (location { lat, lng }, where the icon stands), an optional area (polygon), startsAt / endsAt (UTC, endsAt after startsAt), on/off and details in sv / fr / en (title, description, pickupNote; each language required, title ≤ 80, description ≤ 1000, pickupNote ≤ 300). Drivers: GET /driver/events → { items: DriverEvent[], at } = the events that are on and not ended (running or upcoming within upcomingDays) of the driver's country (the country of his zones), soonest first, the texts in the driver's language (else English, else the country's language). The driver app shows a small premium event icon on the Home map at location; a tap shows name, time, place and the details. Refresh: when an event of his country is created, changed or deleted, every driver config stream of that country gets a config_published with doc 'events' (zoneId = the stream's zone); the app then reads GET /driver/events again (also on start and coming back to the front). No dispatch change, no rider change, no notice (owner did not ask). The driver app's built-in demo events are removed on live.
events.entity: DispatchEvent { eventId, country, name, location { lat, lng }, polygon?, startsAt, endsAt, on, details { title, description, pickupNote: { sv, fr, en } }, version, createdBy?, createdAt, updatedBy?, updatedAt }
events.driverEntity: DriverEvent { eventId, name, location { lat, lng }, polygon?, startsAt, endsAt, running, title, description, pickupNote?, language }

dispatchTools.cancelChecks: F5 (owner 'Later, with new rule'): the Cancel checks screen is built in group 5 with the 'heading to pickup 80 %' rule; not in v0.18.6 (hidden on live until then).

pickupWaiting.note: v0.18.7 (driver group 5 'Going to pickup' and the waiting items it shares with group 6; owner decisions of 2026-10-29, note check 2026-10-29 and answers Q1–Q6 of 2026-10-31, Rules decisions/driver-g5.md and driver-g6.md). The same rules in Sweden and France: every amount comes from the zone's pricing document (admin Pricing) and the zone's app documents, in the zone's currency; nothing is hard-coded in an app. Every text below is in sv / fr / en. Owner rule 16 (2026-10-31): anything the admin can adjust is an admin setting with a default, never a question.

debtByCurrency.note: Q3 (CRITICAL fix): an owed cash fee (cancel or no-show, CONTRACT.md §3.7) is charged again only on a trip in the SAME currency. A rider who owes 100 kr from Stockholm is quoted in Paris without it (never +100 €); the debt waits for the next Swedish trip. The server sums the owed fees per currency: a quote and the fare of the next trip carry outstanding_fee = the owed fees in the pricing document's currency (FareLine.sourceTripId = the oldest of them); a paid cash trip settles only owed fees of its own currency, oldest first.
debtByCurrency.riderView: Rider.outstanding = the owed fees in the rider's oldest owed currency (Money, null when nothing is owed); Rider.outstandingByCurrency = every currency with an owed amount (Money[], one per currency, ascending by first debt). The admin rider view shows all of them.

servedConfig.note: HIGH fix (apps showed 5 kr/min and 50 kr while the server charged 12.26 kr/min and 65 kr; a driver in Paris saw Swedish terms): GET /driver/config and GET /rider/config are always served with waiting (top-level terms and byCategory) and the rider pickup fees taken from the zone's LIVE pricing document (configDocs.mustMatch applied when serving, like the raise limit), whatever the published app document says. So a driver or rider in a French zone gets the French zone's terms in euro, a Swedish one the Swedish terms in kronor. The apps read freeWaitMin, perMin, noShowAfterMin and noShowFee from there (and from TripProjection.terms once a trip exists) and never from their own constants.

cancelAfterArrivedIsNoShow.note: Q2 (owner 2026-10-31 'This can be adjusted by admin'): admin setting per zone or country standard, Settings › Driver app › Waiting (DriverAppConfig.waiting): 'Cancel after the driver arrived counts as a no-show'. Default on. The server copies it to RiderAppConfig.waiting.cancelAfterArrivedIsNoShow when serving GET /rider/config, so the rider app can show the rule in its Terms.

adminText.sv: Avbokning efter att föraren anlänt och den fria väntetiden gått ut räknas som utebliven kund (avgift för utebliven kund)
adminText.fr: Une annulation après l’arrivée du chauffeur et la fin de l’attente gratuite compte comme un client absent (frais de client absent)
adminText.en: Cancelling after the driver has arrived and the free waiting is over counts as a no-show (no-show fee)

terms.note: TripProjection.terms (TripTerms) on every trip, rider, driver and admin views, from booking to the end: the rules this trip is charged by, taken from the booking snapshot (contract.json#bookingSnapshot: the category's waiting terms and cancel rule of booking time) plus the zone's waiting.cancelAfterArrivedIsNoShow and booking.maxPickupMoveMeters at booking time. The apps show these numbers (driver: waiting sheet and no-show confirm; rider: driver-arrived sheet shows the waiting TIME only, the prices go in the Terms — group 6 decision 4) and never their own.

fields.freeWaitMin: free waiting minutes after the driver arrived (reservation: after the booked time)
fields.waitPerMin: Money per minute after the free minutes (charged per second)
fields.noShowAfterMin: minutes after arrival when the driver may mark a no-show
fields.noShowDriverSharePct: the driver's share of the no-show fee (0–100)
fields.cancelRule: FeeRule | null: the rider cancel fee rule (live: freeMin after accept; reservation: freeMin before pickup)
fields.cancelDriverSharePct: the driver's share of a cancel fee (0–100)
fields.maxPickupMoveMeters: how far the rider may move the pickup after booking (pickupMove)

terms.riderView: Contract §2 wins: the rider's view of terms has no noShowDriverSharePct / cancelDriverSharePct, waiting has no noShowDriverShare and cancellation no driverShare (the driver's money is never the rider's to see); the driver and admin views have them.

cancelAfterArrived.note: Q2 rule on the server (rider cancel, POST /trips/{tripId}/cancel): inside the cancel rule's free minutes after accept the rider ALWAYS cancels free (owner 2026-10-29 'before 2 min always free for rider'), also after the driver arrived. After them: the cancel counts as a no-show ONLY when the driver is at the pickup (status arrived), the zone's cancelAfterArrivedIsNoShow is on AND the free waiting is over (now >= waiting.freeUntil: the moment the driver himself could mark a no-show; a reservation's clock runs from the booked time, so an early-arrived driver's rider still pays the reservation late-cancel rule before it) → the fee is the trip's no-show fee (terms.noShowFee, driver share terms.noShowDriverSharePct, rider_fees kind no_show, cancellation.feeKind no_show); otherwise the normal cancel fee (cancelFees, the heading-to-pickup check (v0.18.13 pickupWaiting.headingCheck), cancellation.feeKind cancel). The status stays cancelled_by_rider (the transition table is unchanged). Closes the gap where cancelling after arrival (35 kr) was cheaper than a no-show (65 kr).

cancellationFields.feeKind: cancel | no_show: which rule set the fee (absent when fee is null)
cancellationFields.driverShare: Money: the driver's part of the fee, credited at once (absent when fee is null)

feeAmountsShown.note: Q6 (driver) and the rider side: the apps show the amount, never a silent +35 kr on the next quote. Driver: at arrive the server puts waiting.noShowFee (the fee) and waiting.noShowDriverShare (what the driver gets) on the trip, so the no-show confirm says texts.noShowConfirm; after a rider cancel the driver_cancelled / rider_cancelled event and the projection carry cancellation.fee and cancellation.driverShare, so the island says texts.riderCancelledFee or texts.riderCancelledNoFee (decision 7: 'Rider cancelled' at once, then the amount). Rider: after a cancel the projection's cancellation.fee + feeKind give texts.riderFee / texts.riderNoShowFee / texts.riderNoFee.

noShowConfirm.fr: Marquer comme client absent ? Vous recevez {amount}

noShowConfirmNoFee.sv: Markera som utebliven kund? Ingen avgift
noShowConfirmNoFee.fr: Marquer comme client absent ? Pas de frais

riderCancelledFee.fr: Le client a annulé · Vous recevez {amount}

riderCancelledNoFee.fr: Le client a annulé · Pas de frais

riderSummary.note: Q1 (owner 'First name + rating'): TripProjection.rider = RiderSummary { firstName, rating? } in the driver and admin views from accept to the end (set when the driver accepts, kept on the trip). Never in the rider's own view. No surname, no phone number (call and chat stay as they are). rating = the rider's average (2 decimals) only while the zone's DriverAppConfig.offers.offerCard.riderRating is on (the same switch as the offer card, driverOffers.riderRating); no rating → no field, never a made-up value. The trip screen shows it as the G4 offer card does (one decimal + star).

runningTotal.note: Q5 (rider sees the new total incl. waiting from Start trip): the trip's fare already includes the charged waiting when the driver boards the rider (the board step; start_trip sets it again), so TripProjection.fare is the total the driver asks for. The rider app shows fare, not quote.total, from rider_onboard on (and in the receipt); while the driver waits (status arrived) the projection carries waiting.chargedSecondsNow and waiting.chargedSoFar (Money, read time, no version change) so both apps can show the waiting cost growing, and the rider app shows the TIME only on the driver-arrived sheet (group 6 decision 4).

eta.note: Status item 2 + Q4 (one road-route ETA for both apps): the server computes the ETA every everySeconds from the driver's latest position with its router (Movera's OSRM, else the straight-line estimate; maps.serverRoutes), to the pickup from accept until boarding and to the drop-off from boarding to the end. It is TripProjection.eta (TripEta) on every read and rides on a kind=location event (etaSeconds + eta; no version change) on the trip stream, for the rider, the driver and the admin. Both apps show eta.etaSeconds (whole minutes rounded up, at least 1) and eta.distanceMeters as distanceDisplay says; neither app computes its own ETA for the trip screen (the driver's navigation app is a separate thing).

fields.source: osrm | estimate | stale (stale: the driver sent no position for more than 120 s, dispatch's "gone" age; the previous ETA is kept with at = now, nothing new is routed; the apps show the last number and may say it is old)

distanceDisplay.note: Owner 2026-10-29: kilometres with one decimal from 1 km (3.4 km), 100 m steps under 1 km (900, 800 m …), 10 m steps under 100 m (90, 80 m …). Steps are rounded DOWN so the number only shrinks as the car comes nearer; never under 10 m. The number is formatted in the app's language (sv 3,4 km).
distanceDisplay.rule: meters ≥ 1000 → unit km, value floor(meters / 100) / 10 (one decimal); 100 ≤ meters < 1000 → unit m, value floor(meters / 100) × 100; meters < 100 → unit m, value max(10, floor(meters / 10) × 10)

follow.note: Performance fix (the rider app polled GET /trips/{tripId} every 2 s): the trip screen follows the trip on the SSE stream (GET /trips/{tripId}/events); it polls GET /trips/{tripId} only while the stream is down (and once after a resync), every pollSeconds, never faster. The ETA tick comes on the stream every eta.everySeconds, so there is nothing to poll for. The driver app follows the same rule.

pickupMove.note: Status item 4 + note check (owner '200 m default, admin can change'): the rider moves the pickup with PATCH /trips/{tripId} { expectedVersion, pickup } while the trip is requested, searching, offered, accepted or driver_to_pickup. The server measures the straight-line distance from the BOOKED pickup (the first one) to the new one and refuses more than the zone's booking.maxPickupMoveMeters (the zone's driver document, admin Dispatch › Booking 'Pickup move after accept'; default 200, range 0–2000; server migration sets every published document still on the old 500 to 200): 400 invalid_request, reason pickup_move_too_far, details ["maxMeters=200", "meters=…"]. After the driver arrived: 409 invalid_transition, reason pickup_fixed_after_arrival. A move changes pickup, version + 1, and sends one event of kind pickup_moved (new realtime kind, with the projection, before terminal only) to the rider, the driver and the admin; the driver app re-routes and shows texts.island on the island; open offers show the new pickup on their next read; the fare does not change (≤ 200 m). The other UpdateTripRequest fields (dropoff, stops, routeQuoteId, payment method) are not served yet: 400 invalid_request, reason route_change_not_available (destination change is the next job, decision 5).

tooFar.en: You can move the pickup at most {meters} m. Cancel and book again for another place.

fixedAfterArrival.fr: Le chauffeur est déjà là – le point de départ ne peut plus être déplacé
fixedAfterArrival.en: The driver is already there – the pickup cannot be moved

adminLiveRow.note: Admin phase item: every GET /admin/trips row of a trip with a driver that is not over carries driverLocation (GeoFix) and eta (TripEta), so the live trips table shows driver_to_pickup with the live ETA and a map link (the driver's position and the pickup coordinates; the admin opens its own map). GET /admin/trips/{tripId} carries the same.

next: Status item 5 (destination change with a new price the rider confirms and a driver popup) — next contract; route changes answer route_change_not_available until then.
Status item 3 (Google Maps / Waze choice in the driver app's settings) — app only, no server part.

headingCheck.note: v0.18.13 (owner G5-8, decisions/driver-g5.md item 8 + notes): the smart late rule for live trips. 'Heading to pickup' = in each check the driver got at least headingPct % (default 80, admin per zone, range 50-100) as much closer to the pickup as he could have at normal road speed in the time since the last check (normal road speed = the server's route distance / route duration of the driver's leg to the pickup, else dispatch's pickup speed). It runs with the server ETA, every pickupWaiting.eta.everySeconds (30 s), from accept until arrived, for the whole wait, not only once.
headingCheck.setting: DriverAppConfig.headingCheck { on, headingPct, notHeadingMinutes, reassign } per zone (or the country standard); defaults configDefaults.headingCheck (on, 80 %, 2 min, reassign on). The admin's 'Smart cancel check' / 'Came closer by' controls map to on / headingPct. v0.18.35: + notice (default true) and noticeEveryMin (default 1, range 1-10); reassign default false and read-only (live rides are never taken back).
headingCheck.riderCancel: Inside the cancel rule's free minutes (default 2) the rider always cancels free. After them (live trip, driver not yet arrived): the fee is charged unless the latest check says the driver has NOT been heading for notHeadingMinutes in a row (then the cancel is free, cancellation.fee null). No check yet (a trip accepted before v0.18.13, no position so far) = the normal fee rules. A check without a position changes nothing (the previous state and its clock stay). A driver within the arrive radius counts as heading.
headingCheck.reassign: v0.18.35 (owner Q-A 2026-11-04, contract.json#bookedTakeBack.live): LIVE rides are NEVER taken back by the server. reassign stays in DriverAppConfig.headingCheck (read-only, default false, never deleted) and the server ignores it for live trips. Not heading for notHeadingMinutes in a row only makes the rider's cancel free and sends the driver the notHeadingNotice. (Before v0.18.35: with reassign on the trip went back to dispatch, reason not_heading_to_pickup.)
headingCheck.projection: TripProjection.headingCheck { heading, checkedAt, notHeadingSince?, freeCancel } from accept until arrived (all views): heading = the latest check; freeCancel = a rider cancel now costs nothing because of this rule. The admin dispatch map flags trips with heading false.
headingCheck.replaces: The v0.4 came-closer check (400 m/min x 50 %, measured once at the rider's cancel) is gone.

driverNotice.note: When the trip is taken back (reassign) the driver gets a bell notice + push in his language.

title.sv: Resan gick till en annan förare
title.fr: Course confiée à un autre chauffeur

body.sv: Du var inte på väg till upphämtningen, så resan gick till en annan förare. Det räknas som en avbokning.
body.fr: Vous ne vous dirigiez pas vers le point de prise en charge : la course a été confiée à un autre chauffeur. Elle compte comme une annulation.
body.en: You were not heading to the pickup, so the trip went to another driver. It counts as a cancel.

headingCheck.reasonCode: not_heading_to_pickup (driver_cancels only; never a CancelReasonCode on the wire)

notHeadingNotice.note: v0.18.35 (owner Q-A + job 4 Q4 'On every minutes'): while the driver has not been heading to the pickup for notHeadingMinutes in a row (live and booked trips, accepted / driver_to_pickup), he gets this bell notice + push in his language every noticeEveryMin minutes (DriverAppConfig.headingCheck.noticeEveryMin, default 1) until he heads to the pickup again or arrives. headingCheck.notice false = no notice (admin switch, default on). The last send time is kept on the trip (trips.heading_check.noticeAt), so several server copies never send it twice for the same minute. data { tripId, reason not_heading_to_rider }.

title.fr: Vous ne roulez pas vers le passager
title.en: You are not driving towards the rider

pickupWaiting.cancelReasons: v0.18.13 (owner G5-9 'Load from admin'): DriverAppConfig.cancelReasons (the zone's admin list per sheet) decides which reasons the driver app SHOWS; titles (sv/fr/en) come from DriverAppConfig.texts and the app keeps the built-in list as the offline backup. The server accepts every contract code of the sheet (contract.json#cancelReasons), so an old app that shows the built-in list keeps working; a code of another sheet → 400 invalid_request, reason invalid_reason_code.

arrivedWaiting.note: v0.18.8 (driver group 6 'Arrived and waiting'; owner decisions 1-6 of 2026-10-29, re-check 2026-11-01, Rules decisions/driver-g6.md; builds on v0.18.7 pickupWaiting; X-Api-Version stays 0.5, additive). Every waiting rule the admin sets is enforced by the server: far pickup, airport, event and scheduled-ride rules with their overrides, free wait at each stop; the server picks the matching rule at arrive and the trip carries the effective numbers (TripProjection.waiting + terms), so both apps show the server's numbers and the driver app's local rules go. Rider PIN before Start (per-zone admin switch, default off), admin Reverse no-show, the waiting / no-show / cancel rules in the Terms, island messages when paid waiting starts and when a no-show becomes possible. Sweden and France alike: every amount is in the trip's currency, from the zone's documents; nothing is hard-coded in an app.

rules.source: DriverAppConfig.waiting (Admin › Dispatch › Waiting at pickup, per zone): farPickup { on, km, freeWaitMin, perMin, noShowAfterMin, noShowFee }, rideTypes { scheduled | airport | event: { on, freeWaitMin, perMin, noShowAfterMin, noShowFee, radiusMeters? (event), afterEndMin? (event) } } and stopFreeWaitMin (Admin › Zone › Stops 'Free wait at each stop'). A null field keeps the value it would have without the rule. Money fields are Money in the zone's currency; a Money in another currency is ignored (the category value stays). rideTypes.scheduled.freeWaitMin is the reservation policy's included waiting (the admin publishes it there). The rider document gets the same fields when served (GET /rider/config).
rules.base: The category's waiting terms from Pricing (pricingDocument.categories[categoryId].waiting: freeWaitMin, perMin, noShowAfterMin, noShowFee), as in v0.18.7.

match.airport: the trip's pickup lies in an airport zone (the server's price extra pickupInAirportZone, set at booking)
match.event: at arrive, an admin event (Dispatch › Events, the trip's country) is on and running (startsAt ≤ now ≤ endsAt + afterEndMin, default 0) and the pickup lies inside its polygon, or within radiusMeters (default 500) of its location when it has none
match.far_pickup: a live trip whose driver was more than farPickup.km away from the pickup when he accepted (Offer.pickupMeters of the accepted offer, strictly more than km × 1000)

rules.order: One ride type at most, the first that matches and is on: airport, then scheduled, then event. Then far_pickup on top. A later rule wins where it sets a value. When a rule sets freeWaitMin but not noShowAfterMin, noShowAfterMin follows it (owner decision 5: the no-show time is the end of the free waiting). Finally noShowAfterMin is never below freeWaitMin.
rules.appliedAt: arrive: the server computes the effective terms once, when the driver arrives, and keeps them on the trip (waiting.rules, freeWaitMin, perMin, noShowAfterMin, noShowFee; freeUntil / noShowAt from them). The waiting charge (board), the no-show fee, a cancel that counts as a no-show and the running total all use these numbers.
rules.snapshot: POST /trips keeps the zone's farPickup, rideTypes and stopFreeWaitMin of booking time (contract.json#bookingSnapshot field waitingRules); a later publish never changes a booked trip. A trip booked before v0.18.8 has none: no extra rule, no free stop minutes (as before).

projection.waiting: TripProjection.waiting gains (from arrive) rules: string[] (the applied rule ids, [] = the category's own terms), freeWaitMin, perMin: Money, noShowAfterMin (the effective numbers), paidMinutes (whole minutes of paid waiting, rounded up: from chargedSeconds once boarded, from chargedSecondsNow while arrived; for the admin waiting box — money is still counted by the second) and alerts (see alerts).
projection.terms: TripProjection.terms: from arrive, freeWaitMin, waitPerMin, noShowAfterMin and noShowFee are the effective numbers and terms.waitingRules lists the applied rule ids; before arrive they are the category's. New terms.stopFreeWaitMin (free minutes at each middle stop, 0 = none).

rules.stops: Free wait at each stop (owner re-check 2026-11-01): DriverAppConfig.waiting.stopFreeWaitMin (default 0 = no free minutes, as v0.7.1). stop_waiting charges, per stop, only the seconds after the first stopFreeWaitMin minutes of that stop (Σ max(0, (leftAt − arrivedAt) − stopFreeWaitMin × 60) / 60 × stopWaitPerMin).

defaults.note: Used when the driver document lacks the field: the admin panel's own defaults (Dispatch › Waiting at pickup). Money defaults per currency; another currency: the category's fee.

event.fr: Prise en charge à un événement

far_pickup.fr: Prise en charge à plus de {km} km

pin.switch: DriverAppConfig.pickupPin { required: bool (default false), maxAttempts: int (default 5, 1–10), lockMinutes: int (default 5, 1–60) } — Admin › Zone › Safety 'Rider PIN before Start', per zone. Kept on the trip at booking (Trip.pinRequired); a later switch never changes a booked trip.
pin.code: With pinRequired the server makes a 4-digit PIN (0000–9999, random) when the trip is booked. The rider sees it: TripProjection.pickupPin (rider and admin views only; never the driver's, not on the driver's stream) and GET /trips/{tripId}/pin → PinCode { tripId, pin, expiresAt } (expiresAt = 24 h after booking or the booked time; once the trip is over 404 not_found, reason pin_trip_over). Without pinRequired: no pickupPin; GET /pin answers 404 not_found (reason pin_not_required).
pin.check: The driver sends the PIN: POST /trips/{tripId}/pin/verify { pin } → PinVerification { verifiedPinToken, expiresAt, version }, or directly { pin } in the body of board or start. Guesses are taken only while the trip is arrived (else 409 invalid_transition, reason pin_not_now). A trip with pinRequired cannot be boarded / started until the PIN was right once (TripProjection.pinVerified true): board / start without it → 409 invalid_transition (reason pin_required). A right PIN is its own change: version + 1 and a trip_projection event (the rider's pinVerified updates); with { pin } in board / start the step then goes on from that version (send the version you saw). Wrong PIN → 400 invalid_request (reason pin_wrong, details ['attemptsLeft=N']); after maxAttempts wrong tries in a row the trip is locked for lockMinutes → 429 rate_limited (reason pin_locked, retryAfterSeconds); after 3 × maxAttempts wrong tries in all the PIN is blocked → 429 rate_limited (reason pin_blocked, no retryAfterSeconds) until an admin unlocks it. Tries are counted although the command fails; the comparison is constant-time. verifiedPinToken is informative only (the verification is kept on the trip).
pin.admin: GET /admin/trips/{tripId} carries pickupPin, pinVerified, pinAttempts and pinBlocked (the admin can read the PIN to the driver on the phone). POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/pin/unlock { expectedVersion, reason } (trips.intervene, audited trip.pin_unlock) clears the lock, the block and the counts; the PIN stays.
pin.compat: Default off: live 0.18.7 driver apps keep working. Driver apps from 0.18.8 send the header X-Contract-Version (e.g. 0.18.8) on board / start; for a request without it, or with a lower version, the server skips the PIN check (and logs it), so an older app is never stuck. Admin warning: the switch only protects trips of drivers on the new app.

pin.driverChange: When the trip leaves its driver (driver cancel before boarding, admin reassign, back to dispatch) the PIN state is cleared (verified, tries, lock, block) and a new PIN is made; the rider sees the new pickupPin.

reverseNoShow.note: Admin › Trip › 'Reverse no-show' (owner decision 3 + 34): POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/reverse-no-show { expectedVersion, reason (1–1000 chars, required), takeBackDriverShare?: bool (default false) } — permission trips.manage, audited trip.reverse_no_show. Only a trip with status no_show (else 409 invalid_transition, reason not_a_no_show).
reverseNoShow.effect: The status stays no_show (terminal statuses never change, §3) and the trip gets cancellation.reversal { at, by (adminId), reason, driverShareTakenBack }. The no-show fee goes: an owed fee is waived (feeStatus waived, Rider.outstanding recomputed); a fee already paid is refunded to the rider's wallet (wallet entry kind refund): feeStatus waived plus refundedAt and refundedToWallet true on cancellation (live 0.18.7 apps know only paid / owed / waived). The trip's fare becomes 0 (fareLines []). takeBackDriverShare false (default): the driver keeps his share (earnings unchanged, Movera pays it: commission = − share); true: an earnings adjustment of − share in the trip currency, earnings 0. A fee carried by a ride going on now → 409 conflict (reason fee_on_running_trip), as for a waive. The reversed no-show no longer counts in the rider's no-show count.
reverseNoShow.idempotent: Again on a reversed trip: 200 with the trip as it is, nothing changes, no second audit row (the first reason stays).

alerts.note: Island messages, no sound (owner decision 6). The server books two timers at arrive: at waiting.freeUntil (paid_waiting_started) and at waiting.noShowAt (no_show_possible). When one fires while the trip is still arrived with the same arrival, waiting.alerts gains { kind, at } and a trip_projection event goes out (no version change, like a search step). Apps show each kind once per trip as a short island message without sound; they may also start it from freeUntil / noShowAt themselves (the event is the server's confirmation). A free wait of 0 min fires paid_waiting_started at arrival.

driverNoShow.en: You can now mark a no-show

settings.where: DriverAppConfig.rideCheck (Admin › Safety › Ride check, per zone, live: the server reads the zone's live driver document at each check). GET /rider/config serves the same object as RiderAppConfig.rideCheck (copied from the zone's driver document), so both apps show the same numbers.

fields.on: true = the server starts ride checks in this zone (default true). false = no server checks; the apps also stop their own checks.
fields.stopMinutes: Long stop: the car stood still (every fix within 50 m) this many minutes with the rider on board (default 2; 1–30).
fields.offRouteKm: Off route: the car is farther than this from the trip's route (default 2; 0.5–20). Owner decision 2 (2026-10-29): 2 km.
fields.endFarMeters: Unexpected end: the driver ended the trip (complete, or cancel with the rider on board) farther than this from the drop-off (default 500; 100–5000).
fields.noAnswerSeconds: Nobody answered within this many seconds → the safety team is alerted (an open ride_check incident) (default 120; 30–600). Also used for the apps' own checks.
fields.repeatMinutes: The same reason does not ask again within this many minutes of the trip (default 10; 1–120).
fields.noAnswerAlarm: true = a no-answer case also rings the admin alarm and escalates like an SOS; false (default, as v0.12.0) = it shows in the safety list without sound.

settings.invalid: A missing field or one outside its range reads as the default.

detection.when: From every POST /driver/location batch while the trip is rider_onboard, in_trip or approaching_dropoff (a server job, a few seconds later), and at the driver's complete / cancel.
detection.long_stop: The trip boarded at least stopMinutes ago and every fix (accuracy ≤ 50 m) of the last stopMinutes is within 50 m of the newest one, the fixes cover the whole stopMinutes, the car is not at a middle stop the driver tapped arrived at, and not within 300 m of the drop-off.
detection.off_route: The newest fix (accuracy ≤ 50 m) is farther than offRouteKm from the trip's route: the server's road route pickup → stops → drop-off (kept on the trip, made again after a route change), straight lines between those points when the road route has no shape.
detection.dropped_far: Unexpected end: the driver completes or cancels with the rider on board farther than endFarMeters from the drop-off (the driver's latest fix). The trip still ends; the rider may answer up to safety.rideCheck.completedWithinMinutes (30) after it.
detection.possible_crash: Stays with the apps (phone sensors); the apps report it as before.
detection.once: One open server check per trip at a time; the same trigger again only after repeatMinutes.

ask.projection: TripProjection.rideCheck { checkId, trigger, askedAt, answerBy, answers { rider?, driver? }, alertedAt? } on the rider's, the driver's and the admin's view (every viewer). checkId starts with srv_. Sent as a trip_projection event without a version change; also on every GET /trips/{tripId}.
ask.apps: Both apps open the same 'Is everything OK?' card (texts below) when rideCheck has a checkId they have not answered and their own side has no answer, and answer with the existing POST /{rider|driver}/trips/{tripId}/ride-check { checkId, trigger, at, answer } (contract §22). A shown report is not needed (the server already counts the card as shown at askedAt).
ask.answers: ok on one side does not close the other side: each side answers for itself. need_help (either side) opens the ride_check incident with the alarm at once (§22). Each answer updates rideCheck.answers (trip_projection event, no version change).
ask.noAnswer: A side with no answer at answerBy (askedAt + noAnswerSeconds): the server opens (or joins) the trip's ride_check incident, raisedBy system, rideCheck.answer no_answer, alarm = noAnswerAlarm, and sets rideCheck.alertedAt.

adminList.row: RideCheckRow { tripId, zoneId, side: rider | driver, checkId, origin: server | app, trigger, shownAt?, answer?: ok | need_help, answeredAt?, noAnswerAt?, incidentId?, position?, measured?: { value, unit: min | km | m } (server checks: minutes stopped, km off the route, metres from the drop-off when asked), answerSeconds? (the zone's noAnswerSeconds when asked), createdAt }, newest first; nextCursor. A served DriverAppConfig / RiderAppConfig rideCheck never carries the pre-v0.18.9 finishFarFromDropoffKm; endFarMeters is the one setting.
adminList.answerFilter: answer = ok | need_help | no_answer | waiting (no answer yet, not timed out).

settings.where: DriverAppConfig.routeChange (Admin › Dispatch › Stops: 'Change stops during trip', 'Driver can refuse', per zone, live). Served also as RiderAppConfig.routeChange (copied from the zone's driver document).

fields.on: true (default) = the rider may change the destination or add / remove stops once a driver has the trip. false = 409 route_change_off.
fields.driverCanRefuse: true (default) = the driver gets Accept / Refuse. false = the change applies at once and the driver is only told (status accepted, answeredBy system).
fields.answerSeconds: The driver's time to answer (default 60; 15–300). No answer = refused (status expired): the trip keeps the old route.
fields.beforePickup: true (default) = the rider may also change the route before being picked up (accepted, driver_to_pickup, arrived), with the same driver Accept / Refuse. false = only once on board (rider_onboard, in_trip, approaching_dropoff); before that 409 route_change_before_pickup_off. Owner rule 16 (2026-11-01, G7 open question 1).
fields.fixedPriceTrips: "block" (default) = a fixed-price route trip cannot change its route (409 route_change_fixed_route). "switch_to_normal" = the change is allowed and, once accepted, the trip leaves its fixed price and is priced like a normal trip (the trip's pricing document, surge and car type, without the fixed route). Owner rule 16 (2026-11-01, G7 open question 4).

settings.invalid: A missing field or a value outside its range / values reads as the default.

flow: 1. Rider: POST /trips/{tripId}/route-quote { expectedVersion, dropoff?, stops } → 201 RouteQuote { routeQuoteId, tripId, total, difference, fareLines, dropoff, stops, expiresAt } (the new price; no driver money). dropoff absent = the current one. Valid 5 minutes.

2. Rider confirms: PATCH /trips/{tripId} { expectedVersion, routeQuoteId } → 200 TripProjection with routeChange { status: pending } (version + 1, trip_projection event). With driverCanRefuse false the route changes in the same call.

3. Driver: POST /trips/{tripId}/route-change/accept or /route-change/refuse { expectedVersion, changeId } → 200 TripProjection. Accept: dropoff, stops, fare, fareLines, driverEarnings and the route change at once. Refuse (or no answer in answerSeconds → expired): nothing changes, the trip goes on to the old destination.
4. Rider may withdraw a pending change: POST /trips/{tripId}/route-change/withdraw { expectedVersion, changeId }.
routeChange.projection: TripProjection.routeChange { changeId, routeQuoteId, status: pending | accepted | refused | expired | withdrawn, dropoff, stops, total, difference, askedAt, answerBy, answeredAt?, answeredBy?: driver | rider | system, driverEarnings?, earningsDifference? } — the latest change of the trip; driverEarnings and earningsDifference only in the driver and admin views.
routeChange.price: Owner decision 5 of v0.4.3 (§3 'Route-change pricing'), in practice: total = current fare + (price of the new route − price of the current route), both priced with the trip's own pricing document, surge and car type (distance, time, stop fee, app fee, minimum); never below half of (booked fare + raises); difference = total − current fare (may be negative). The driver's new earnings = current earnings + (his share of the new route − his share of the current route); raises stay. Cash: the difference is only shown.

rules.maxStops: The new stops may not pass the zone's maxStops (400 too_many_stops, details maxStops=N).
rules.visitedStops: Stops the driver already tapped arrived at must stay first, in the same order (400 visited_stop_changed).
rules.onePending: One pending change at a time (409 route_change_pending).
rules.fixedRoute: A fixed-route trip: fixedPriceTrips block → 409 route_change_fixed_route; switch_to_normal → the route quote prices the new route at the normal price (total = current fare + (normal price of the new route − fixed price), never below half of (booked fare + raises)); RouteQuote.leavesFixedPrice true; on accept the trip's fixedRouteId is removed, so the end fare is the normal price.
rules.quote: An expired or used route quote → 409 route_quote_expired / route_quote_used; a route quote made at another trip version → 409 version_mismatch on PATCH.
rules.off: Zone switch off → 409 route_change_off; status outside statuses → 409 invalid_transition.
rules.answer: accept / refuse with another changeId or a change no longer pending → 409 route_change_not_pending.
rules.beforePickup: beforePickup false and the trip still before pickup (beforePickupStatuses) → 409 route_change_before_pickup_off.

finish.note: v0.18.10 (driver group 8 'Finish & cash'; owner items 1–2 of 2026-10-29, Q1–Q4 of 2026-11-01, the re-checks of 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-01; Rules decisions/driver-g8.md). CONTRACT.md §36. Sweden and France alike; every number is a per-zone (or country standard) admin setting with a default (owner rule 16); every text in sv / fr / en (Swedish rider = resenär). No other company's logo: Apple Pay is shown as text only (owner rules: Apple / Google logos only on sign-in buttons). X-Api-Version stays 0.5; additive except google_pay leaving the enums.

paymentMethods.adminSetting: RiderAppConfig.paymentMethods (and DriverAppConfig.paymentMethods, same list) of the zone or the country standard = the methods the admin turned ON (Admin › Settings › Payment methods, per country, every zone of it or one zone). Default: cash, card, apple_pay.
paymentMethods.serverSupport: The server takes only the methods it has a payment company for (today: cash only; card and Apple Pay need a payment company, owner 'Coming soon until a payment company is chosen'). v0.18.13 (audit M5, rule 2 'admin settings must really work'): this list is in the server's code, not a deployment setting, so the admin's per-zone switches decide what riders see; the old PAYMENT_METHODS environment list is no longer read. The only server-side override is the emergency kill-switch environment variable PAYMENT_METHODS_PAUSED (comma list, default empty): cash can never be paused (listed cash is ignored and logged); any other method listed there is served as coming_soon and refused with payment_method_coming_soon even if the admin turned it on, until it is taken off the list.
paymentMethods.served: GET /rider/config and GET /driver/config add paymentOptions: [{ method, status: available | coming_soon }] in the admin's order, one per method the admin turned on: available = the server takes it now, coming_soon = on in admin but not taken yet. A method the admin turned off is not listed. The rider app shows available methods to pick and coming_soon ones greyed with texts.comingSoon; it never shows a method that is not listed.
paymentMethods.booking: POST /trips (the trip's paymentMethod, in the quote's zone; POST /quotes only records it): a method the admin turned off in that zone → 400 invalid_request, reason payment_method_off; on in admin but not taken by the server → 400 invalid_request, reason payment_method_coming_soon; anything else (google_pay, wallet, unknown) → 400 invalid_request, reason payment_method_not_available. The app shows texts[reason] and goes back to the payment choice, never a silent fail. Changing the method of a booked trip stays unavailable (PATCH answers route_change_not_available, as before).
paymentMethods.migration: Server migration 0045: google_pay is taken out of every stored rider / driver document (live, draft, history) and of the trips / quotes check; a trip or quote with google_pay never existed (booking always failed). Defensive: any trip with google_pay is set to cash before the check is changed.

tips.endpoint: POST /trips/{tripId}/tip { amount: Money, method: cash | card | apple_pay } (rider; Idempotency-Key) → 201 TripTip { amount, method, driverShare, at }. Also accepted as RatingRequest.tip (+ tipMethod, default cash) with the rating: the same rules.
tips.rules: One tip per trip. Allowed when the trip is completed, or ended early by the rider (end_early). amount must be one of the zone's enabled tip amounts, in the trip's currency. method cash: the rider gives the tip in the driver's hand; card / apple_pay only when that method is available (finish.paymentMethods.served), else payment_method_coming_soon / payment_method_off.
tips.driverShare: 100 % to the driver (owner item 1): an earnings entry kind tip of the full amount; Movera keeps nothing. A cash tip is also counted as cash the driver already holds (cashCollected), so the weekly payout does not pay it a second time.
tips.projection: TripProjection.tip { amount, method, at } on the rider, driver and admin views once given (event tip_added as a trip_projection event without a version change, also sent after the trip ended).
tips.earnings: GET /driver/earnings: tips in EarningsPeriod.tips (and in net); cash tips also in cashCollected. Payouts: the tips line (PayoutLine tips), cash tips subtracted in cash_collected. The trip's driverTotal includes the tip.

tips.settings: RiderAppConfig.tipRules { cashAfterTrip (default false), cashInCarMinutes (default 5, 0–60), customAmount (default false), customMax: Money (default SE 200 kr, FR 20 €) }, Admin › Tips & limits, per zone or country standard; missing / out of range = default. cashAfterTrip false: a cash tip is only accepted while the rider is still in the car = within cashInCarMinutes after the trip ended (the finish screen); later → 409 tip_cash_after_trip_off (card / Apple Pay tips are not limited). customAmount true: besides the preset amounts the rider may type any whole amount from 1 up to customMax (above → 400 tip_above_max); false: presets only (400 tip_amount_not_allowed). customMax never unlimited: a document without one uses the country default, else 20 × the highest preset amount.
tips.withRating: RatingRequest.tip: the rating is saved first; a tip that cannot be given does not lose the stars: the answer is the rating (201, or 200 with only tipError for a skip) with tipError { code, reason, message } and no tip.

earlyEnd.rider: Owner G8 Q1 'Cash screen + rating (Recommended)': when the rider ends early (POST /trips/{tripId}/end-early) the driver gets the normal finish: TripProjection.finish (driver and admin views; rider view without the driver's money) with endedEarly true, endedBy rider, the amount for the distance driven (finish.total), the cash to collect (finish.cashToCollect), his money (finish.driverTotal + earningsBreakdown) and ratingAllowed true; driverRatingStatus is pending, so POST /driver/trips/{tripId}/rating works on a cancelled_by_rider trip ended by end_early. The driver app shows the cash sheet with this amount (texts.driverRiderEnded), then the rating, never straight Home. Stop waiting already charged is kept.
earlyEnd.driver: Owner G8 Q2: the driver completes farther than pricing.completeNearDropoffMeters (300 m) from the drop-off. Paid stop waiting (fee and minutes) is always kept. The price is worked out again only when the trip is shorter than booked by MORE than DriverAppConfig.cancelFees.earlyEnd.repriceOverKm km (default 2) AND MORE than repriceOverMin minutes (default 10) (v0.18.33, owner fix-plan Q1: BOTH; before v0.18.33 either one was enough and the minutes default was 8): then the rider pays what was driven (never more than booked) plus the stop waiting; otherwise the booked price stands (plus the stop waiting) and the trip is still marked ended early. Distance short = booked distance − km on board (trip trace); time short = booked minutes − minutes on board. The numbers are kept on the trip at booking (bookingSnapshot earlyEnd), read from the zone's live driver document (or the country standard), out of range = default. The same rule applies when the driver cancels with the rider on board (builder question 4, one rule): re-priced only over the limits, else the booked price (+ stop waiting).

settings.where: DriverAppConfig.cancelFees.earlyEnd { repriceOverKm, repriceOverMin } — Admin › Cancellation, per zone or country standard.

earlyEnd.projection: TripProjection.finish { endedEarly, endedBy?: rider | driver, reasonCode?, repriced?: boolean, total, cashToCollect, driverTotal?, earningsBreakdown?, ratingAllowed } on every ended trip with a fare (completed, end_early, driver cancel on board). driverTotal and earningsBreakdown only on the driver and admin views. CompletePreview gains earlyEnd details: repriced, shortKm, shortMin.

driverMoney.rule: Owner G8 Q3 'One number (Recommended)': everywhere the server sends the driver's money for a trip it also sends driverTotal = driverEarnings + pickupPay + driverBonus + tip + Movera's changes (adjustments, incl. a refund taken from the driver), with earningsBreakdown [{ code: trip | pickup_pay | bonus | tip | adjustment, amount }] (only lines that are not 0, trip always). Apps show driverTotal as 'Your share' (texts.yourShare) on the offer-free screens: cash sheet (CompletePreview.driverTotal), finished screen, trip history, admin; the breakdown under it. driverEarnings keeps its old meaning (the fare part only) for older apps.
driverMoney.where: TripProjection.driverTotal / earningsBreakdown (driver and admin views, every trip with a driver and money), CompletePreview.driverTotal / earningsBreakdown, Receipt (not), Offer (unchanged: the offer already shows the total incl. pickup pay).
driverMoney.payChange: POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/driver-pay { change: Money (non-zero, the trip currency), reason } (finance.edit, Idempotency-Key) on an ended trip with a driver → 200 TripProjection (admin): an earnings entry kind adjustment of change (paid with the next payout), trip.driverAdjustments += change, driverTotal moves; audit trip.driver_pay with before / after / reason; the driver gets a bell notice kind driver_pay_changed (texts.payChanged). Errors: driver_pay_not_ended, driver_pay_no_driver, driver_pay_below_zero (driverTotal would go below 0), currency_mismatch. Checker: the size of one change (plus or minus) is at most CountryRules.driverPayChangeMax of the trip's zone (Admin › Tips & limits, per zone or country; default SE 1000 kr, FR 100 €) → else 400 driver_pay_above_max. A refund taken from the driver never takes more than his one number on the trip (never below 0).

debt.bug: Live 2026-11-01: the driver's finished screen and the admin 'Who gets what' showed 'Movera commission −257,95 kr' on a 318 kr cash trip that carried the rider's 240 kr old fee: the old fee was counted as Movera's commission.
debt.rule: commission = fare − debtCollected − driverEarnings − pickupPay − driverBonus, where debtCollected = the trip's outstanding_fee line (an earlier fee the rider pays with this trip; it settles the old trip's fee, whose driver share was already credited then). TripProjection.debtCollected (driver and admin views) and Receipt.debtIncluded show it as its own line (texts.debtLine). Server migration 0045 corrects commission on stored trips.
debt.moneySplit: Admin view only: TripProjection.moneySplit { riderPaid, driverTotal, movera, debtCollected, tip?, refunded } — 'Who gets what'. riderPaid = fare + tip − refunded; driverTotal is the driver's one number (incl. tip, Movera's pay changes and refunds taken from him); movera = riderPaid − driverTotal − debtCollected, so driverTotal + movera + debtCollected = riderPaid always (a refund Movera pays and a pay change lower Movera's part; the tip is never Movera's).
debt.earningsEntries: Older earnings_entries rows are not affected: their trip line already stored commission as fare − the old fee − earnings (§3.7).

safety.rule: Owner G8 Q4 'Only with a driver (Recommended)': the rider's SOS (112 + alert Movera) only once a driver is assigned (safety.sos.riderStatuses, server-enforced since v0.18.5: 409 trip_not_live); plain 'Call 112' (safety.onlyDuringTrip.texts.call112) is always in the safety menu.
safety.projection: TripProjection.sosAvailable (rider and driver views): true while the status is in safety.sos.riderStatuses / driverStatuses. The rider app shows SOS only when true, else only Call 112.

refund.existing: For the admin trip page (Give money back): POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/refund { expectedVersion, amount: Money, reason, fromDriver? } (payments.refund) → 201 Refund (or 202 PendingApproval over the role limit). At most what the rider paid (cash + wallet) less earlier refunds (400 refund_too_large); only a paid ended trip (409 not_paid). fromDriver true ('take from driver', owner decision 31): the driver loses his share of the refunded money (an earnings adjustment − share), now also in driverTotal / driverAdjustments. The rider chooses where the money goes (POST /rider/refunds/{refundId}/destination); the admin marks a Swish / bank refund paid (POST /admin/refunds/{refundId}/paid, finance.edit). Lists: GET /admin/refunds/payouts.

admin.settings: Settings › Payment methods: per country (standard) or zone, ticks cash ('Pay in car'), card, Apple Pay → RiderAppConfig.paymentMethods and DriverAppConfig.paymentMethods (publish both); show 'Coming soon' next to card / Apple Pay while GET /rider/config paymentOptions says coming_soon. No Google Pay column. Tips & limits: tip amounts per country / zone (country_rules.tips), defaults SE 10 / 20 / 30 kr, FR 1 / 2 / 5 €. Cancellation: 'Ended early by the driver: new price only when more than X km or Y min shorter' → DriverAppConfig.cancelFees.earlyEnd.
admin.tripPage: Give money back → refund (finish.refund.existing, incl. Take from driver). Change pay → POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/driver-pay. Resend receipt → POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/receipt/resend. Receipt view → GET /admin/trips/{tripId}/receipt. Who gets what → TripProjection.moneySplit / debtCollected / driverTotal + earningsBreakdown; tip → TripProjection.tip; ended early → TripProjection.finish.

finish.compat: Additive for 0.18.9 apps except: google_pay is no longer a PaymentMethod / ZonePaymentMethod value (no trip ever had it: booking with it always failed); live apps that still offer Google Pay get 400 payment_method_not_available instead of a silent fail. Older driver apps ignore finish / driverTotal and keep driverEarnings.
finish.next: Driver app: cash sheet + rating after the rider's early end, 'Din andel' = driverTotal everywhere, tip line. Rider app: payment list from paymentOptions (Pay in car, card / Apple Pay coming soon, no Google Pay, no logos), tip buttons from RiderAppConfig.tips → POST /trips/{tripId}/tip, receipt with ended early, SOS only when sosAvailable. Admin: finish.admin.
finish.paymentsAdmin: Payments › refund policy, reconcile, disputes, retry and rules stay 'Not connected yet' on live until a payment company is chosen (cash only today).

drivingLimits.note: v0.18.13 (owner 2026-11-02, decisions/driving-time-limits.md: 'It's 12 hours driving (mean driving to pickup or on trip) not online time !! And yes enforce' + '6 hours offline so reset all time'): the SERVER enforces DriverAppConfig.drivingLimits of the driver's first zone (or the country standard). Counted time = driving to the pickup (accept → arrived) + on trip (rider on board → end); online, waiting at the pickup and idle time do not count. The counter starts again after resetAfterOfflineHours (default 6) offline in a row; otherwise it covers at most the last 24 hours.
drivingLimits.enforced: Once counted time ≥ maxHoursPerDay (default 12; 0 = no limit) the driver gets no new offers (dispatch, radar, admin sends), POST /driver/availability online answers 409 conflict reason driving_limit_reached (details ["drivenMinutes:<n>", "maxMinutes:<n>", "canDriveAt:<RFC 3339>"]; the projection carries Driver.drivingTime), and a running trip is always finished.
drivingLimits.projection: Driver.drivingTime { drivenMinutes, maxMinutes, reached, resetAfterOfflineHours, canDriveAt? } on GET /driver/profile: canDriveAt = when the counter resets if the driver stays offline from now (only when reached).
drivingLimits.restMinutes: restMinutes stays the break length the app shows (not enforced by the server in v0.18.13).

countryLimits.note: v0.18.14 (owner rule 16, deep fix 2026-11-02; g1-g3 H2, M2, M6): admin limits per country in CountryRules.limits of the country standard (standard-<CC>). A missing value or one outside its range reads as the default. At sign-in the phone's calling code decides the country (+46 SE, +33 FR, +216 TN); another code uses the defaults.

fields.wrongCodesPerDay: Wrong sign-in codes for one phone number from one client address in 24 h before that address is locked for that number (429 otp_locked_today) until the oldest leaves the window; admins can unlock.
fields.codesPerAddressPerHour: Sign-in codes per client address (one wifi) per hour (429 otp_too_many).
fields.uploadsPerHour: Document uploads per driver per hour (429 rate_limited reason upload_limit); the driver's country.
fields.codesPerPhonePerHour: Sign-in codes per phone number and app per hour (429 otp_too_many).
fields.writesPerUserPerMinute: v0.18.24 (owner 2026-11-04 "Yes, admin setting"): writes (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) per signed-in user per minute (contract.json#rateLimit; 429 rate_limited reason too_many_requests); the user's country (first zone of the token).
fields.writesPerAddressPerMinute: v0.18.24: writes per client address per minute for callers without a valid token (sign-in, waiting list); the country of the server's default zone.
