deepFix1.note: v0.18.14 (deep fix round 1, Rules plan/FIX-LIST-2026-11-02.md). What the server does now; what the apps must follow.
deepFix1.earlyEnd: An early end (rider end-early, driver cancel on board, driver completes before the drop-off) keeps what was earned before it: the paid pickup waiting (line waiting, 100 % the driver's), the child seat (extras), the pickup airport fee (airport) and the reservation fee; the drop-off airport fee is not charged. The driven price is capped by the booked fare moved by every accepted route change (not the first booked fare).
deepFix1.routeChange: See onTrip.routeChange.driverPush (push to the driver + the driver-app 'own echo' rule).
deepFix1.tips: A zone document whose tips are all in another currency than the trip's is ignored: the country's own amounts apply (a Paris trip ended early could not be tipped).
deepFix1.earnings: GET /driver/earnings?currency=SEK|EUR: one currency per report (default the currency of the driver's first zone, in that zone's time zone). EarningsReport gains currency and currencies (every currency he earned in during the range, for a kr / € switch). Amounts of another currency are never added in.
deepFix1.vehicles: GET /driver/vehicles always lists the driver's active car (Driver.vehicleId) first even when it is not one of his fleet's cars; every item has active: true|false. Dispatch offers a trip only when the active car is approved and has the trip's category (a Komfort trip needs a Komfort car); re-approving a car without a ride type removes it from the chosen types of its drivers. An approved car with no categories stored does not narrow the driver's chosen types (older rows; the admin should re-approve it with its categories).
deepFix1.documents: A driver gets no offer while one of his REQUIRED documents, or a required paper of the car he drives, is past its end date (the same rule as the offline sweep); online drivers are set offline by the expiry sweep (offlineReason documents_expired); one on a trip at its end.
deepFix1.signIn: Codes stay 4 digits (owner). otp_locked_today per number + address; admin unlock; countryLimits (wrongCodesPerDay, codesPerAddressPerHour, codesPerPhonePerHour, uploadsPerHour). One phone at a time for drivers: a new driver sign-in ends his other sessions — their calls and POST /auth/refresh answer 401 reason signed_in_elsewhere (auth.signedOut.reasons); the old phone is set offline (the driver goes online again from the new phone) and a notice kind signed_in_elsewhere is sent. Riders keep several phones.
deepFix1.accountChange: POST /account/phone/change { phone } → OtpChallenge; POST /account/phone/verify { phone, sessionId, code } → { phone }. POST /account/email/change { email } → { challengeId, expiresAt, delivery: pending_provider }; POST /account/email/verify { challengeId, code } → { email }. Only within 10 minutes of signing in on this phone (403 reauth_required: sign in again first); at most 3 starts per hour per account and kind (429 change_too_many). A number or address that already has any account (rider or driver) gets the same answer and no code, and the verify fails like a wrong session (invalid_otp_session / invalid_email_challenge) — the answer never tells. Wrong tries carry over a restart (5 per hour, auth.otp). After the change: a notice to the OLD number / OLD address (sent by SMS / e-mail once a provider is connected; recorded as pending until then), an in-app notice (phone_changed / email_changed), and every other session of the account ends.
deepFix1.notifications: GET /notifications shows title and body in the account's current language when the notice was stored with every language (data.texts, taken out of the answer): set_offline, signed_in_elsewhere, phone/email changed, rider trip moments. Rider trip moments (riderTripPush) are now also kept in the list (bell true). A refund sends the rider a notice kind refund (bell + push).
deepFix1.legal: GET /legal/{country} carries company { companyName?, orgNumber?, address?, supportEmail?, supportPhone? } from admin Content › Legal (the sign-in 'Need help?' box).
deepFix1.pin: board / start never skip the PIN: X-Contract-Version no longer matters; a PIN trip without a verified PIN is 409 pin_required.
deepFix1.refunds: Take from driver: share = min(refund, fare − old debt) × earnings ÷ (fare − old debt), never more than his money on the trip. An approved refund reads the trip as it is at approval (no version conflict). The rider gets a refund notice.
deepFix1.activation: POST /admin/drivers/{id}/status active is 409 details_missing for a driver who never sent his details (no country).
deepFix1.countryRules: The sample settings seed each country's country_rules standard (GET /admin/config/country_rules?country=SE|FR no longer 404).
deepFix1.dispatchLock: A dispatch round locks and reads only the drivers of the trip's zone and its neighbour zones.
deepFix1.birthDate: A date of birth that does not exist (2001-02-31) or before 1900 is 400 invalid_date_of_birth.
deepFix1.addMoney: Owner 2026-11-02 (driver-g5): admin Add money (Exclusive / Radar) goes to the simply nearest free drivers, same-country neighbour-zone drivers included when neighbours are on; reach limits, busy and declined filters stay. The in-zone-first rule is gone.
deepFix1.rideUpdates: Owner 2026-11-02 (driver-g13): Rider.consents.rideUpdates false stops only 'driver found' and 'arriving'; 'driver arrived', 'a new driver' and 'trip cancelled' are always sent.
deepFix1.arrivePosition: arrivedWaiting.positionMaxAge applies to driver apps sending X-Contract-Version ≥ 0.18.14; older apps keep the old arrive check.

bookLater.note: v0.18.17 (CONTRACT.md §41). Booked rides (Trip.kind scheduled) end to end, every value an admin setting per zone in DriverAppConfig.reservations (Admin › Dispatch › Reservations; defaults contract.json#configDefaults.reservations). Sweden, France and Tunisia alike (owner Q7 'All countries now'). Owner answers 2026-11-03 Q1–Q7 (Rules decisions/driver-g15.md). The airport queue is a separate job.
bookLater.window: Q1: POST /quotes and POST /trips with kind=scheduled refuse a pickup less than minAheadMin minutes ahead (400 invalid_request, reason booking_too_soon) or more than maxAheadDays days ahead (reason booking_too_far), from the zone's live driver document. RiderAppConfig.booking.minAheadMin, maxAheadDays and freeChangeBeforeMin are written by the server from the same zone's DriverAppConfig.reservations when it serves the rider document (one source). A booked ride whose route is longer than maxTripKm km (default null = no limit, owner BL-Q5; the demo admin's 'Max Trip Distance (Reservations)' setting) is refused at quote: 400 invalid_request, reason trip_too_long (live rides are not limited by it).
bookLater.plan: Q2: ahead = scheduledAt − booking time. ahead < soonBeforeMin → mode now: the trip takes start_search at booking, like a live ride (the zone's Exclusive then Radar rules). Otherwise mode list: the trip stays requested, is shown in GET /driver/reservations?scope=open to the drivers listTo picks (listOpenAll: after listOpenAllAfterMin minutes to every driver of the zone), and when noticeOn a reservation notice (push kind reservation_new) goes at booking to at most noticeMaxDrivers of them, nearest to the pickup first; when homePopup, still untaken after homePopupAfterMin minutes (and before dispatchAt) a second notice (kind reservation_popup) goes to the same drivers (the driver app shows it as the Home popup). Still untaken at dispatchAt = scheduledAt − dispatchBeforeMin (default 30, owner BL-Q2; never before booking): start_search like a live ride. A booked ride's search never ends by itself (owner Q3 'keep searching', BL-Q7): an ended search starts again; after the pickup time it starts again as Exclusive offers only, until a driver takes it or an admin acts. fixtures/book_later.json#plan.

listTo.rules: all = every driver of the zone; category = drivers whose active car drives the trip's category; rating = drivers rated at least listMinRating (no rating yet counts as 5); random = listGroupSize drivers picked once at booking; nearNow = drivers whose last position is within listNearKm of the pickup at booking; group = the members of driver group listGroupId (Admin › Events & groups); areaRegulars = drivers with at least listAreaTrips completed trips from the pickup zone in the last 30 days. homeNear = drivers whose home area (Driver.homeArea, set in the driver app, PUT /driver/home-area) is within listHomeKm of the pickup; favourites = the rider's favourite drivers (marked after a ride, PUT /rider/favourite-drivers/{driverId}); nearAtTime = drivers whose last ride before the pickup ends within listAtTimeKm of it at most listAtTimeMin minutes before the pickup time (their accepted booked rides; owner BL-Q4).
listTo.always: Every listed driver must also be active, have scheduled rides on in the zone (reservations.on) and drive the trip's category; a driver never sees a ride that clashes with one he already holds (smart gap: [scheduledAt, scheduledAt + duration + spareMin] of both rides overlap) when hideClashing is on.

bookLater.noDriver: Q3: at scheduledAt − noDriverAlertMin a trip with no driver (requested, searching or offered) is marked TripProjection.reservation.noDriver true (the admin's Alerts and Reservations show 'Booked ride soon with no driver') and the rider gets push kind reservation_no_driver; the search goes on (it starts at once if it had not). BL-Q7: at the pickup time with still no driver, TripProjection.reservation.overdue becomes true (the admin's alert 'Booked ride: pickup time passed, no driver'); the ride never expires by itself.
bookLater.card: Q4 'Charge at booking': a scheduled trip paid by card or apple_pay is charged the full price when it is booked (Trip.paymentStatus captured at POST /trips); a free cancel refunds it. Card payments are still 'coming soon' on live (POST /trips answers payment_method_coming_soon), so nothing is charged until the payment company is connected; the rule is in place for then.

driver.list: GET /driver/reservations?scope=open → DriverReservationPage: the untaken list-mode rides the driver may take (bookLater.listTo), soonest first; scope=accepted → the driver's own accepted scheduled rides (status accepted), soonest first. 403 reservations_off when the zone's reservations.on is false (open scope only).
driver.accept: POST /driver/reservations/{tripId}/accept { expectedVersion? } → TripProjection (status accepted, transition accept from requested). The first tap wins: another driver already took it → 409 conflict, reason reservation_taken; the search started (dispatch) → 409 reservation_in_dispatch (the ride comes as a normal offer); a clash with a held ride → 409 reservation_clash; not listed for this driver → 404 reservation_not_open. The rider gets push kind reservation_driver_found (Q5 rider: a message when a driver takes the ride).
driver.release: POST /driver/reservations/{tripId}/release { reasonCode } (a scheduled cancel reason code) → 204: the ride goes back to the list (transition cancel driver accepted → requested, scheduled), the driver's reminders are taken back; it counts in his cancel rate; with less than driverLateCancelHours to pickup it is a late cancel. After dispatchAt it goes straight back to dispatch.
driver.start: POST /driver/reservations/{tripId}/start → TripProjection (head_to_pickup, accepted → driver_to_pickup), from scheduledAt − onlineBeforeMin of the ride type; earlier → 409 conflict, reason reservation_too_early.
driver.reminders: Q5: after accept the driver gets push kind reservation_reminder at scheduledAt − each rideTypes.<type>.reminderMin (default 120 minutes only, owner M6-a; a time already passed is skipped) and kind reservation_go_online at scheduledAt − onlineBeforeMin (default 60, the zone may set 30). Still offline offlineBackupAfterMin minutes after that: the driver loses the ride (it goes back to the list, or to dispatch after dispatchAt), push kind reservation_lost.
driver.rideType: airport when the pickup or drop-off is in an airport zone; longTrip when the route is longer than longTripKm; comfortPremium for the comfort and premium categories; else normal (event: not detected by the server yet, acts as normal).
driver.keep: POST /driver/reservations/{tripId}/keep { keep: boolean } → TripProjection: the driver's answer to the rider's change (owner BL-Q6). No open question → 409 invalid_transition.
driver.homeArea: PUT /driver/home-area { lat, lng, label? } (label at most 120 chars) or DELETE → the Driver profile with homeArea { lat, lng, label? } (owner BL-Q4: set in the driver app; admins see it on GET /admin/drivers/{driverId}).
driver.notStarted: A held ride not started (still accepted) at its pickup time: TripProjection.reservation.notStarted true (the admin's alert 'Booked ride: pickup time, driver has not started').
driver.assigned: Owner M6-a: the moment a booked ride becomes the driver's (his Accept, an admin-assigned offer, a dispatched offer, a kept change) he gets push kind reservation_assigned.

rider.reminder: Q5 rider: push kind reservation_reminder at scheduledAt − riderReminderMin (default 60; 0 = off), and reservation_driver_found when a driver takes the ride.
rider.change: Q6: more than freeChangeBeforeMin minutes (default 60) before pickup the rider may change the booking: POST /trips/{tripId}/reschedule { quoteId, expectedVersion } with a new kind=scheduled quote (the app shows its new price first) → TripProjection with the new places, time and price; a driver who held it is asked 'Keep it at the new time?' (push kind reservation_change_ask, TripProjection.reservation.changeAsk { until, previousAt }; POST /driver/reservations/{tripId}/keep { keep }); Yes keeps it (rider told reservation_driver_found), No or no answer within changeAnswerMin (default 15) puts it back on the list (transition release, push reservation_changed) and the ride is planned again (bookLater.plan). Later → 409 conflict, reason change_too_late. Not a scheduled trip, or not before pickup → 409 not_a_reservation.
rider.cancel: Q6: POST /trips/{tripId}/cancel more than freeChangeBeforeMin minutes before pickup is always free; later the reservation cancel fee rule of booking time applies (RiderAppConfig.cancelFees, reservation; unchanged). v0.18.33 (fix job 5, owner fix-plan Q3 + Q5): this also holds before any driver took the ride: under freeChangeBeforeMin the fee is charged even with no driver, and Movera keeps all of it (no driver share). contract.json#afterTestRules.bookedCancel.
rider.projection: TripProjection.reservation (kind scheduled only) = { mode: now | list, dispatchAt, freeChangeUntil, noDriver, overdue, changeAsk? { until, previousAt }, mustBeOnlineAt? (driver views) }.
rider.favourites: GET /rider/favourite-drivers → { items: [{ driverId, firstName }] }; PUT /rider/favourite-drivers/{driverId} (only a driver of one of the rider's completed trips, else 404 driver_not_found) and DELETE (owner BL-Q4: marked after a ride).

admin.actions: Existing endpoints on a reservation: assign a driver (POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/assign), send to a driver group (POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/radar-group), cancel (POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/cancel). New: POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/reservation/unassign { expectedVersion, reason } (accepted → requested: the driver is taken off and told, the ride goes back to the list) and POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/reservation/dispatch-now { expectedVersion } (requested → searching now). Both trips.intervene, the admin's zones only, audited (reservation.unassign, reservation.dispatch_now). The admin's unassign tells the driver with push kind reservation_unassigned (never the offline text).
admin.policy: The booking policy (window, free change / cancel time, rider reminder, no-driver alert) is per zone in DriverAppConfig.reservations, saved on the server by publishing the zone's driver document like every Dispatch setting (owner Q1 'admin setting per zone').

push.note: Push and Notifications list (bell), in the person's language (else the zone country's, else English); {time} is the pickup time HH:MM in the zone's time zone, {driver} the driver's first name. Deep links: rider movera://trips/{tripId}, driver movera-driver://reservations/{tripId}.

liveFixes.note: v0.18.19 (Book later live test 2026-11-03, Rules audits/live-book-later-2026-11-03.md). Builds on v0.18.18 (merged; test-account list for admins only).
liveFixes.noShowTime: HIGH 1: POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/no-show on a booked ride (kind scheduled) is refused before the pickup time plus the trip's no-show wait (terms.noShowAfterMin, else the category's waiting): 409 conflict, reason no_show_too_early. Live rides keep their rule (status arrived and the wait over).
liveFixes.ownerDefaults: MED 4: a zone document whose reservations.rideTypes still hold the old built-in values (onlineBeforeMin 30 for normal, reminderMin [60, 15]) and that no admin changed since (no publish after 2026-11-03 touching them) gets the owner values (normal onlineBeforeMin 60, reminderMin [120]) by a server migration; every other value stays.
liveFixes.offlineGive: MED 7: an admin may give (assign) or offer (radar group) a booked ride to a driver who is offline when the pickup is more than dispatchBeforeMin away: the offer reaches him as a notice and the must-be-online rule applies. A group offer skips drivers who cannot take it (offline for a ride soon, on a trip, wrong category) and answers skipped: [{ driverId, reason }]; only when nobody can → 409 no_free_driver. Such an offer stays open until dispatchAt (not the usual seconds) and the driver gets push kind reservation_offered. A driver who already has an open offer of this ride is not offered it again: his offer is answered under kept (no second offer, no second notice).
liveFixes.driverFoundOnce: MED 9: the rider gets 'driver found' once per driver of a ride: never again for a keep (Yes) or a re-accept by the same driver; a new driver after a change or a give-back → once for him.
liveFixes.riderReminder: MED 8: the rider reminder (riderReminderMin) is planned again after every change, admin send-now and give-back, and is sent while the ride is not over (also when a driver is already on the way).
liveFixes.horizon: LOW 15: RiderAppConfig.booking.bookingHorizonDays is served equal to maxAheadDays (older apps).
liveFixes.zoneOff: Owner A: with the zone's reservations.on false, POST /quotes and POST /trips with kind scheduled answer 403 forbidden, reason reservations_off. The rider app never hides Book later / Later: tapping it there shows bookLater.texts.zoneOff.
liveFixes.includedWaiting: Owner B: a booked ride's free waiting (waiting.rideTypes.scheduled.freeWaitMin, per zone, the admin's 'Included waiting') counts from the pickup time, never from the driver's arrival: Waiting.freeUntil = scheduledAt + freeWaitMin (also when the driver arrives late). Riders and drivers see it in TripProjection.terms / waiting.
liveFixes.raiseFare: Owner C (v0.18.19): raising the driver's fare of a booked ride works exactly like a live ride: the admin call is POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/driver-bonus with the same Pricing bonus limit. The zone's DriverAppConfig.reservations.raiseFare (false: refused, reason raise_off) and raiseMax (major units; the lower of it and the live limit applies; null, the default, = no cap of its own: the live limit only) are saved on the server from Dispatch › Bokningar.
liveFixes.driverShown: Owner D: the rider sees the driver (name, photo, car: TripProjection.driver) only from driver_to_pickup on; while a driver holds the booked ride for later the rider view has driverAssigned true and no driver details, and reservation_driver_found names nobody. The admin switch 'Rider sees the driver at once' becomes this fixed rule.
liveFixes.noEarlyAssign: Owner E: no early auto-assign and no backup driver: an untaken or given-back booked ride stays on the list until dispatchBeforeMin (30) before pickup, then Exclusive + Radar. The admin fields for those show 'Coming soon'.
liveFixes.includedWaitingPolicy: Owner 2026-11-03: ONE included waiting for every zone (admin 'Included waiting' of the reservation policy), saved on the server: GET /admin/reservations/policy (trips.read) → ReservationPolicy { includedWaitingMinutes, rev, updatedAt }; PUT /admin/reservations/policy { expectedRev, includedWaitingMinutes 0–60 } (trips.intervene; 409 version_mismatch when another admin saved first). A kind scheduled trip's free waiting is this many minutes, counted from the pickup time; the no-show time is never before its end.
liveFixes.riderZoneSwitch: Owner A (v0.18.19): RiderAppConfig.booking.reservationsOn is the zone's DriverAppConfig.reservations.on, written by the server when it serves the rider document. The rider app never hides Book later; with reservationsOn false a tap says bookLater.texts.zoneOff and no booking starts. POST /quotes and POST /trips with kind scheduled still answer 403 forbidden, reason reservations_off.
liveFixes.driverListReservation: Live test 2026-11-03 HIGH 2: each DriverReservation row of GET /driver/reservations carries reservation (ReservationInfo, driver view) with changeAsk, leaveAt and driveSeconds, so the driver app asks Keep it at the new time? (new time and new earnings) from the list, the notice tap and the details screen. Before, the row had no changeAsk and the question never showed.
liveFixes.leaveOnTime: Owner 2026-11-03: for a booked ride a driver holds, the server works out the drive from his live position to the pickup (by the real road route from the server's router, Movera's OSRM, else the straight-line estimate: the same live ETA source as a normal ride's pickupWaiting.eta) and when he must start to arrive arriveEarlyMin (zone setting, default 10) before the pickup time: TripProjection.reservation.leaveAt and driveSeconds (driver and admin views), recomputed every 2 minutes from 3 hours before pickup as he moves. At leaveAt he gets push kind reservation_leave_now (once); the driver app counts down to leaveAt. If he has not started 5 minutes after leaveAt, or his drive no longer fits before the pickup time, reservation.atRisk becomes true (admin alert 'Driver may be late for a booked ride') and he gets reservation_late_risk (once). Smart assign: when a booked ride is searched (dispatchBeforeMin, Exclusive), drivers who can arrive arriveEarlyMin before the pickup time are asked first. The 3 steps (early, on time, the rest) rank by dispatch's own drive estimate (straight line × road factor at dispatch.score.pickupKmh, the number the offer shows as pickupEtaSeconds): routing every candidate by road inside a dispatch round would add one road request per driver per round; the leave-time check, one driver every 2 minutes, uses the road route. The rider sees the driver ('Driver on the way') from driver_to_pickup on (liveFixes.driverShown).
liveFixes.badge: Owner 2026-11-03: a booked ride always shows the reservation badge ('Booked ride' + pickup time) wherever a driver sees it: Booked rides, Home popup, Exclusive offer, Radar (Home and the Live list) and the accepted trip. Offer.reservation is true for every offer of a kind scheduled trip (with Offer.scheduledAt); TripProjection.kind scheduled for the trip.

dispatchDriverFacts.who: Drivers of the zone (zone_ids contains zoneId) with account active and online status online (state free) or on_trip (state trip), nearest-first order is the admin's job; items are sorted by driverId.

real.idleMin: Whole minutes since the driver was last free (drivers.last_free_at, the §3.6 idle factor); null on a trip or when unknown.
real.categoryIds: The categories the driver may take (Driver.categoryIds).
real.missedInRow: Exclusive or assigned offers of live trips missed in a row since going online, counted exactly as contract.json#autoOffline (an accept resets it).
real.ridesThisHour: Trips of this driver that ended completed in the last 60 minutes.
real.restNeeded: true when the driving-time limit is reached (contract.json#drivingLimits).

dispatchDriverFacts.notYetRule: The server does not track these yet: they are always null. The admin shows a dash (—) and never invents a value; alerts never fire on a null fact.
dispatchDriverFacts.apps: Driver and rider apps: no change (admin-only read).

adminLiveEvents.note: BASE job 'admin live updates' (Rules plan/BASE-JOBS-SPEC-2026-11-04.md §3; owner L1 2026-11-04: a small 'Reconnecting…' badge, data still refreshes every minute). One admin stream instead of 15 s polling. An event only says WHAT changed (type + id + zone); the admin panel then reads the record again with the normal list/detail routes and their permissions. No names, money or text on the stream.
adminLiveEvents.transport: Accept: text/event-stream → SSE: `id:` is the sequence, `data:` one AdminLiveEvent, a heartbeat comment every 15 s. Without it: a JSON page AdminLiveEventPage of the events after `after` (polling fallback, same scope).

trip.changed.when: a trip is created, or its status, driver, zone or payment status changes

driver.status.when: a driver's online status or account status changes (one event per zone of the driver)

zone.supply.when: the free / busy driver count of a zone may have changed (a driver went online, offline, on or off a trip in it); entityId = zoneId

alert.changed.when: an alert is created or taken, passed, done, snoozed (admin_alert_records)

ticket.changed.when: a support ticket is created or its status, owner or last message changes

incident.changed.when: an incident is created or its status changes

approval.changed.when: an approval is asked for or decided

payment.failed.when: a trip's payment status becomes failed; entityId = tripId (a trip.changed is sent as well)

resync.when: the cursor is older than the kept events (retentionHours): the panel reloads every live list once; entityId = the admin's id, zoneId null

scope: An admin hears an event only for a zone he covers (token zones; '*' = all zones). An event with zoneId null (no zone) only reaches '*' admins — the same rule as the dispatch feed and the alert desk.
Optional query zoneId / zoneIds / country narrows the stream inside the admin's own zones (contract.json#adminListFilters rules: a named zone outside them is 403 zone_out_of_scope).
An admin without a type's permission never gets that type.
Country managers (roles/zones job) are scoped by the same zone list; nothing on this stream changes when that job lands.
adminLiveEvents.replay: `after` query or the Last-Event-ID header: the stream starts with every event after that sequence (in scope), then goes live. Events are kept retentionHours; an older cursor gets one `resync` event first, then live events.

limits.overLimit: 429 rate_limited, reason too_many_streams, Retry-After; the panel keeps polling every fallbackPollSeconds and tries again later
limits.serverReads: one shared read per change for all open streams (not one per stream)

reconnectBackoff.jitter: full jitter: a random wait between 0 and the current step

client.reconnect: EventSource reconnects by itself with Last-Event-ID. While it is not open the panel shows a small 'Reconnecting…' badge (owner L1 a) and refreshes the live lists every fallbackPollSeconds; never a big warning banner.

adminLiveEvents.apps: Rider and driver apps: no change (they use their own trip / offer / config streams). RULE 0 check only.

rateLimit.note: BASE job B11 (architecture audit 2026-11-03 item 9): one general write limit on top of the existing sign-in limits (auth.limits, countryLimits, waitlist, admin sign-in), which stay as they are.
rateLimit.applies: every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE under /api/v1; reads (GET, HEAD) and CORS preflights (OPTIONS) are never counted
rateLimit.key: a valid access token: its actor and user (sub), so many accounts behind one address never share a budget; no or an invalid token: the client address (the address the trusted proxy saw, TRUST_PROXY_HOPS)
rateLimit.window: fixed 60 s window per key, in the server's memory
rateLimit.signInOutsideProduction: Owner 2026-11-04: on staging only, a test number (auth.testSignIn, no real SMS) has no resend wait (otp.retryAfterSeconds; the challenge says retryAfterSeconds 0) and no hourly per-number or per-address code limit, under a cap of 30 codes per number per minute (429 otp_too_many); production keeps every OTP limit and has no test numbers. staging and development: POST /auth/otp/request and /auth/otp/verify are not counted per address (load test); the OTP limits still apply. Production counts them.
rateLimit.settings: v0.18.24 owner 2026-11-04 "Yes, admin setting": per country in CountryRules.limits of the country standard (contract.json#countryLimits writesPerUserPerMinute, writesPerAddressPerMinute; Admin › Settings › Request limits), applied within about 60 s without a server release. The server environment RATE_LIMIT_WRITES_PER_USER_PER_MINUTE / RATE_LIMIT_WRITES_PER_ADDRESS_PER_MINUTE is the fallback and the floor: the limit used is the higher of the two (staging keeps its higher env values); env 0 turns that limit off.
rateLimit.error: 429 rate_limited, reason too_many_requests, retryable true, header Retry-After = whole seconds until the window ends

clients.driver: ApiError.isRetryable is true for 429; the queued trip commands keep their Idempotency-Key and retry; account screens show the wait from Retry-After
clients.rider: riderErrorKind maps 429 / rate_limited / too_many_requests to rateLimited and shows the wait from Retry-After
clients.admin: ApiError.retryable from the body, Retry-After read into retryAfterSeconds; reads retry at most twice and wait Retry-After (at most 60 s) before retrying; message 'Too many attempts. Wait N s.'

previewSession.note: BASE job 'admin real app preview' (Rules plan/BASE-JOBS-SPEC-2026-11-04.md §1; owner P1 a, P2 b, P3 a, 2026-11-04). The admin panel shows the REAL rider and driver web apps inside a phone frame on every page that showed a drawn sample phone (Content, Design, Messages, Bonuses, Promos, Riders). The apps talk to the live server with a preview token; every real action is blocked.
previewSession.token: An access token (§8) with actor = role, zones = [zoneId], sub = 'preview:<role>:<zoneId>' and the extra claim pv = true (preview). No refresh token; no auth session row; after ttlSeconds the admin asks for a new one.
previewSession.handoff: The admin opens the app web build in an iframe at <appUrl>#movera-preview=<token>&zone=<zoneId>&draft=<0|1>. The token is in the fragment, so it never reaches a web server log. The panel can send a new token or draft choice with window.postMessage({type:'movera-preview', token, draft}) and the app reloads its config.
rules: A preview token can only READ: every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE by it is refused with 403 forbidden, reason preview_blocked, before any route code runs (no booking, accept, payment, going online, payout, chat or profile change is ever stored).

GET /rider/config and GET /driver/config with ?draft=1 return the admin's saved draft of that zone (falls back to live when no draft) — ONLY for a preview token; any other caller gets the live document.
A preview token is never counted as a real rider or driver: no supply, no dispatch, no metrics.

Owner 2026-11-04 (B: Empty screens): a preview token's own-account reads answer what a brand-new account gets, never an error and never fake data: empty lists, a blank profile (firstName "", driver active + offline), a zero wallet; the normal 'no active trip' (204) and 'not in a fleet' (404 no_fleet) answers stay. The apps show their usual 'nothing yet' states.
An app that holds a preview token shows a 'Preview' banner, and every Book / Accept / Pay / Go online style action shows 'Preview – not sent' instead of calling the server (owner P1 a).
previewSession.embedding: The app web builds must allow being framed by the admin origin (no X-Frame-Options DENY; Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors, when set, includes the admin origin).

phoneDataToServer.note: v0.18.26 (BASE B13, owner 2026-11-03 "Phone-only data: Yes, all to server", Rules decisions/admin-fake-by-group.md): the rider's saved places, the driver's ride preferences (switched-off categories) and the driver's emergency contacts are kept on the server, not only on the phone. Builds on v0.18.23; 0.18.24 (rate limit) and 0.18.25 (preview) land first. Additive except SavedPlace / SavedPlaceRequest (never served before: no server had /rider/places); X-Api-Version stays 0.5.
phoneDataToServer.privacy: Each list is read and changed only by its owner (the signed-in rider for places, the signed-in driver for preferences and contacts); another rider or driver never sees it and an id of someone else's place is 404 place_not_found. Admins only read (never edit): emergency contacts through an OPEN safety case of that driver, saved places and ride preferences on the rider / driver profile page; every admin view is written to the admin audit without the addresses, names or numbers. Logs never carry them.

riderPlaces.routes: GET /rider/places -> SavedPlacePage (every place, nextCursor null); POST /rider/places SavedPlaceRequest -> 201 SavedPlace; PUT /rider/places/{placeId} SavedPlaceRequest -> 200 SavedPlace; DELETE /rider/places/{placeId} -> 204; POST /rider/places/import SavedPlaceImport -> 200 SavedPlacePage.
riderPlaces.kinds: kind home and kind work: one each; saving a new home (or work) replaces the old one and keeps its placeId. kind other: as many as maxPlaces allows, each with its own placeId. type is the app's finer word for an other place (gym, mall, school, airport, family, restaurant, other); the app picks the icon and label from it.
riderPlaces.place: SavedPlaceAddress { address (required, 1-512), lat?, lng? }: places saved on phones before v0.18.26 have only the address text, so the position is optional.
riderPlaces.maxPlaces: Admin setting per country, per person: countryLimits.savedPlacesPerPerson (default 50, 1-500).
riderPlaces.tooMany: 409 conflict, reason too_many_places, past the country's savedPlacesPerPerson (home and work count).
riderPlaces.import: One-time upload of the places a phone kept before v0.18.26. Applied only the first time for this rider (the server remembers it); later calls change nothing and answer the server's list. Items follow the POST rules (home / work replace, others added); items past maxPlaces are dropped. The app calls it once after sign-in, then reads GET /rider/places and from then on the server's list is the one shown.
riderPlaces.app: Rider app: Home and Saved places read the server's list; add, edit and delete call the routes above; the phone keeps a copy only to show something while offline. Sign-out clears the phone copy (the server keeps the places).

driverPreferences.categoriesOff: The ride categories the driver switched off in Ride preferences (CategoryId[]; an unknown id is 400 invalid_request, reason unknown_category). Empty = every category his account and car allow.
driverPreferences.dispatch: The server does not send a switched-off category: the automatic dispatch rounds (Exclusive and Radar), the admin's Add money sent through the zone's dispatch, and the Scheduled rides list skip a driver whose categoriesOff holds the trip's category. Driver.categoryIds (given by the admin from the car) is unchanged by this choice. Owner 2026-11-04 'Yes, respect it': admin hand-sent offers (assign, radar to chosen drivers) and group / radar-zone sends skip him too; the send lists him in skipped with reason category_switched_off, and a single assign to only him is 409 invalid_transition, reason category_switched_off.
driverPreferences.updatedAt: null until the driver saves once on the server; the app then uploads the choice it kept on the phone once (one-time upload) and afterwards follows the server.
driverPreferences.app: Driver app: Ride preferences reads and saves through these routes; the phone copy only shows something while offline. Offers already filtered by the server stay filtered in the app too.

driverEmergencyContacts.routes: GET /driver/emergency-contacts -> EmergencyContactList; PUT /driver/emergency-contacts EmergencyContactListUpdate -> EmergencyContactList (the whole list each time).
driverEmergencyContacts.item: EmergencyContact { name 1-80, phone (digits, optional leading +, 3-15 digits), relation? 0-40 }. 112 is built into the app and never stored.
driverEmergencyContacts.maxContacts: Admin setting per country, per person: countryLimits.emergencyContactsPerPerson (default 10, 1-50).
driverEmergencyContacts.tooMany: 400 invalid_request, reason too_many_contacts, past the country's emergencyContactsPerPerson.
driverEmergencyContacts.updatedAt: null until saved once on the server; the app then uploads its phone list once (one-time upload).
driverEmergencyContacts.app: Driver app: Emergency contacts reads and saves through these routes.

admin.emergencyContacts: GET /admin/incidents/{incidentId}/emergency-contacts (incidents.read; the incident's zone must be in the admin's scope, else 403 zone_out_of_scope) ; owner 2026-11-04 'Yes, during a safety case': only while the case is open (status open or investigating), else 409 invalid_transition, reason incident_closed -> IncidentEmergencyContacts { incidentId, driverId, items, updatedAt, rider: { riderId, items, updatedAt } | null }: the emergency contacts of the incident's driver, read-only. An incident without a driver answers items []. Every read writes the admin audit line incident.emergency_contacts_viewed (who, when, which incident; never the numbers).
admin.panel: Admin > Safety case (open): read-only 'Driver's emergency contacts' behind a Show button. Admin > Rider profile: read-only 'Saved places' behind Show. Admin > Driver profile: read-only 'Ride preferences' (switched-off categories) behind Show. Every Show is audited by the server; admins never edit.
admin.riderPlaces: Owner 2026-11-04 'Read-only on profile': GET /admin/riders/{riderId}/saved-places (riders.read; a zone-limited admin only for a rider with a trip in his zones, else 403 zone_out_of_scope; unknown 404 rider_not_found) -> AdminRiderSavedPlaces { riderId, items: SavedPlace[] }. Audit line rider.saved_places_viewed (count only).
admin.driverPreferences: Owner 2026-11-04 'Read-only on profile': GET /admin/drivers/{driverId}/preferences (drivers.read; driver's zones in scope, else 403 zone_out_of_scope; unknown 404 driver_not_found) -> AdminDriverPreferences { driverId, categoriesOff, updatedAt }. Audit line driver.preferences_viewed.
admin.limits: Admin > Pricing > Tips & limits per country: 'Saved places per person' and 'Emergency contacts per person' (countryLimits in CountryRules.limits of the country standard).

riderEmergencyContacts.note: Owner 2026-11-04 'Yes, same as drivers': the rider's emergency contacts (rider Safety) move to the server like the driver's.
riderEmergencyContacts.routes: GET /rider/emergency-contacts -> EmergencyContactList; PUT /rider/emergency-contacts EmergencyContactListUpdate -> EmergencyContactList (whole list). Same item, limit (countryLimits.emergencyContactsPerPerson) and too_many_contacts as drivers.
riderEmergencyContacts.updatedAt: null until saved once on the server; the rider app then uploads its phone list once.
riderEmergencyContacts.app: Rider app: Safety > Emergency contacts reads and saves through these routes; the phone copy only shows something offline.

walletCurrency.note: v0.18.28 (fix job 6, ledger L11/R11, owner Q4 2026-11-04, Rules decisions/driver-g15.md 'Fix-plan Q4: leave old wallet rows; show balances per currency from now on'). Numbered after 0.18.24-0.18.27 (reserved by other open jobs). Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5.
walletCurrency.rule: The rider's wallet keeps ONE balance PER CURRENCY (SEK, EUR, TND). Money goes into the balance of its own currency (a France refund is EUR) and a trip is paid only from the balance in the trip's currency. Nothing is ever converted or added across currencies.
walletCurrency.getWallet: GET /wallet?currency=EUR (rider): Wallet { ownerId, balance: Money, balances: [Money], updatedAt }. balance is the balance in the asked currency (0 when the rider holds none); without currency, in the currency of the rider's zone (the zone of his last map or price call), else SEK. balances lists every non-zero balance, one per currency, sorted by currency code. currency must be 3 capital letters, else 400 invalid_request.
walletCurrency.usedFirst: The wallet still pays first (rider.wallet.usedFirst), but only the balance in the trip's currency: walletApplied, cashToCollect, complete-preview cashDue and the receipt's walletPaid are computed from that balance.
walletCurrency.entries: WalletEntry.amount carries the currency of the money moved (unchanged shape).
walletCurrency.admin: The admin rider view (GET /admin/riders, rider status changes) keeps wallet: Money (the balance in the currency of the rider's zone, else the first he holds) and adds wallets: [Money] (every non-zero balance, one per currency). The admin panel shows each balance in its own currency, never a sum.
walletCurrency.oldRows: Old rows are untouched (owner Q4, rule 21): earlier wallet entries keep their values; the single old balance (always shown to the rider as SEK) is copied once as the SEK balance and is no longer written.
walletCurrency.apps: Rider app: shows each balance in its own currency (never a sum) and pays a trip only from the balance in its currency. Driver app: no change (the driver never sees the rider's wallet; cashToCollect already comes from the server).

riderModeration.note: v0.18.29 (A2, owner G16 Q16-1 + Q16-2 'Warn → Pause → Ban'): the admin sets a rider's level with POST /admin/riders/{riderId}/moderation (permission riders.block, Idempotency-Key, expectedVersion, written in the audit). Every level carries a reason; the admin can undo (level none).

levels.warning: the rider can ride and sees the notice (Rider.moderation on GET /rider/profile); Rider.status active
levels.paused: for pauseDays (1..365) set by the admin; Rider.status suspended until moderation.until, then active again by itself; sign-in and booking answer 403 account_suspended (projection = Rider.moderation)
levels.banned: until the admin undoes it; Rider.status suspended; 403 account_suspended

reasons.note: the admin picks one of these suggested reasons or writes their own (1..300 characters); the rider sees the reason text as written.

riderModeration.statusCommand: POST /admin/riders/{riderId}/status stays: active = level none, suspended = level banned with the note as reason.

payoutHold.note: v0.18.29 A2 (owner build-spec Q4 2026-11-02: 'can pause any one payment from his profile'): POST /admin/drivers/{driverId}/payout-hold { held, reason } (finance.edit, Idempotency-Key, audit payout.hold / payout.release) pauses or releases that driver's payouts from the driver's profile. While held no scheduled payout is made for him; his earnings stay unpaid. On release the next run pays every ended period he missed. Driver.payoutHold { reason, at, by } on the admin view (absent = not held). The driver app is not told the reason.

walletCredit.note: v0.18.29 A2 (owner G12 Q5 'Real credit + limit', Q-D 'Max 250 euro and equivalent', build-spec Q2 'One button on rider page', Q1 'One admin always'): the one way an admin gives a rider money is Add money to wallet on the rider's page. POST /admin/riders/{riderId}/wallet-credit { amount, reason } (finance.edit, Idempotency-Key, audit rider.wallet_credit). The amount is in the rider's currency: the country of the rider's latest trip (else of his last seen zone); a rider with no known country is refused 409 rider_country_unknown, an amount in another currency 400 wallet_currency_mismatch. One credit is at most CountryRules.walletCreditMax of the rider's COUNTRY (fix job 0, owner A2-1 2026-11-05 'Per country, in Pricing'): the value on the country's Standard in Pricing › Tips & limits; a zone's own value is ignored; missing or in another currency = the default below. The limit is in that country's currency and is checked only against a credit in that currency (wallet per currency, contract.json#walletPerCurrency of fix job 6): the credit goes into the rider's balance of that currency and is never converted. Above it 400 wallet_credit_too_large, details 'max <amountMinor> <currency>' (no second admin). The wallet gets a WalletEntry kind adjustment; the rider gets a bell + push kind wallet_credit (texts below) and sees it in the wallet history as 'Credit from Movera'. The balance never goes below 0 (credits are positive).

pushBody.sv: Movera har lagt till {amount} i din plånbok.
pushBody.fr: Movera a ajouté {amount} à votre portefeuille.

payoutMode.note: v0.18.29 A2 (owner build-spec Q4 'Admin can set automatic or manual'): CountryRules.payoutMode of the country standard (Pricing › Tips & limits on the Standard; a zone's own value is ignored), automatic (default) or manual. automatic: the scheduled run makes payouts pending (to pay) at the country's payoutSchedule, as before. manual: the run makes them pending_approval; nothing is paid until an admin approves the run with POST /admin/payouts/runs/approve { country, periodEnd, reason } (finance.edit, Idempotency-Key, audit payout.run_approve with the reason; fix job 0, owner A2-3 2026-11-05 'Yes, reason required': reason 1..300 characters, missing or empty = 400 invalid_request, reason reason_required): every pending_approval payout of that country and period inside the admin's zones becomes pending; the answer is { country, periodEnd, approved, total: Money[] (one per currency) }. A pending_approval payout cannot be marked paid (409 run_not_approved). The driver app shows pending_approval as pending (GET /driver/payouts never returns pending_approval). Changing the mode changes only later runs. One admin is enough (Q1); a single driver can still be held (payoutHold).

smallFixes.note: v0.18.30 (FIX JOB 7 'Small fixes', L20-L24, owner Q8/Q9 of 2026-11-04 in Rules decisions/driver-g15.md, B-k/B-l of plan/LIVE-50x50-FIX-PLAN-2026-11-04.md). Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5; no migration.

Without a bias point, or outside every zone, the language is as for /geocode: Accept-Language (sv | fr | en), else the rider's saved language, else sv.

quotePickupTime.rule: L22, owner Q8 'Only for booked rides': Quote.pickupAt is the pickup time of a BOOKED ride (QuoteRequest kind scheduled: the scheduledAt the quote was priced for). A live quote has pickupAt null and the apps show no pickup time on it. Quote.etaSeconds is not filled (kept for older apps).

samePoint.rule: L23, owner Q9 'Warn him but can accept booking': when the straight-line distance from pickup to drop-off is samePointWarnMeters or less AND the ride has no stops, POST /quotes still answers 200 with the prices and adds QuoteList.warnings [{ reason: same_pickup_dropoff, meters, limitMeters }]. It is a warning, never an error: the rider may book the quote (POST /trips does not check it).
samePoint.setting: booking.samePointWarnMeters per zone in the driver document (RiderAppConfig.booking.samePointWarnMeters shows the same number); admin Dispatch › Rides 'Shortest ride (m)'; default configDefaults.samePointWarnMeters 100; range 0-1000; 0 = never warn.
samePoint.shape: QuoteWarning { reason: same_pickup_dropoff, meters int, limitMeters int }
samePoint.rider: Shows the warning above the price cards ('Pickup and drop-off are almost the same place ({meters} m). You can still book.') and keeps Book enabled.

ticketReasons.invalid_ticket_category: 400 invalid_request: POST /support/tickets with a category that is not a ticket category (support.ticketCategories). Before v0.18.30: invalid_body.

adminReadOnly.rule: L21: an admin field the server never reads is shown read-only with the note 'Not used yet' and is never deleted (owner rule 21).

alertsOldList.note: v0.18.31 (owner Q-Bj 2026-11-05 'Never auto-close', Rules decisions/driver-g15.md; pre-merge B-j/P20). Builds on v0.18.30 main. Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5.
alertsOldList.rideCheck: A ride_check alert turns solved (green, kept, owner A2) once its trip has ended (trip status completed, cancelled_*, no_show or expired, or the trip's end time set). solvedT: 'Trip ended {0}'.
alertsOldList.neverAutoClose: SOS and safety alerts (kinds sos, sos_slow, car_lost) are NEVER closed or solved by the server while their incident is open or investigating: only an admin closes them (Incidents) or marks them done.
alertsOldList.old: When the alert's trip ended more than oldAfterHours ago, the alert stays open and LiveAlert carries old: true and oldSince (= trip end + oldAfterHours). An alert without a trip never becomes old. old is missing on every other alert.
alertsOldList.admin: The Alerts page shows old alerts only in a separate 'Old' tab (sv 'Gamla', fr 'Anciennes', en 'Old'), never in the open list; an admin can still take and close them there.
alertsOldList.apps: Rider and driver apps: no change (RULE 0 check only).

afterTestRules.note: v0.18.33 (fix job 5 'After-test rules', ledger R25/L36/R28/R29; owner fix-plan Q1/Q3 2026-11-04 and fix plan 2/4/5/7 Q5/Q6/Q7, Rules decisions/driver-g15.md). Builds on v0.18.32 main. CONTRACT.md §58. Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5.

earlyEnd.rule: Owner fix-plan Q1: a driver who ends before the drop-off re-prices the trip only when it is BOTH more than repriceOverKm km AND more than repriceOverMin minutes shorter than booked (before: either one). Example (2 km / 10 min): 3 km and 5 min shorter = the booked price stands; 3 km and 12 min shorter = the driven price (never more than booked).
earlyEnd.defaults: DriverAppConfig.cancelFees.earlyEnd { repriceOverKm 2, repriceOverMin 10 } (configDefaults.earlyEnd; ranges unchanged). A trip keeps the numbers of booking time (bookingSnapshot earlyEnd); a trip booked before v0.18.33 keeps its stored numbers but is judged with the BOTH rule.
earlyEnd.admin: Admin › Cancellation, per zone or country standard: 'New price only when BOTH shorter by more than (km)' default 2 'and (minutes)' default 10.

bookedCancel.rule: Owner fix-plan Q3: a rider who cancels a booked ride less than freeChangeBeforeMin minutes (default 60) before pickup always pays the reservation cancel fee of booking time (RiderAppConfig.cancelFees, reservation), also when no driver has taken the ride yet. More than freeChangeBeforeMin before pickup stays free.
bookedCancel.noDriver: Owner Q5 ('Movera keeps it'): with no driver yet the whole fee is Movera's (cancellation.driverShare 0, no driver earnings). TripProjection.cancellation { fee, feeStatus owed, feeKind cancel } as for any rider cancel fee; the fee is owed by the rider (outstandingFee). A booked ride whose pickup time has passed with still no driver is always free to cancel (Movera did not deliver it): owner Q-P17 (Rules decisions/driver-g15.md, 'booked ride past pickup with no driver … rider told, no fee').
bookedCancel.apps: Rider: the cancel sheet shows the fee under freeChangeBeforeMin minutes before pickup even with no driver (sv 'Avbokning mindre än {min} min före hämtning kostar {fee}', fr 'Annuler moins de {min} min avant la prise en charge coûte {fee}', en 'Cancelling less than {min} min before pickup costs {fee}'). Admin › Book later: freeChangeBeforeMin help text 'Cancel under (min) costs the fee, even before a driver takes it'.

bookedNext.rule: Owner Q7 + answer 2026-11-05 ('Driver on trip can receive exclusive (can be exclusive trip or reservation but it's exclusive! Any kind of exclusive) but driver receives trip when he soon arrives to drop off! Maybe 70% of the route to drop'): a driver on a trip gets only Exclusive offers (never Radar, never a list), for a live ride or a booked ride alike, and only once the rider is on board and he has driven at least CountryRules.onTripOffers.minRouteDonePct (default 70) % of his current trip's route: done = 1 − (dispatchKm from his position to its drop-off) / (its booked km). A booked ride also needs its pickup at most bookedNext.withinMin minutes away and his current trip (+ the drive from its drop-off) to end by the booked time. km and the score are counted from the current trip's drop-off.
bookedNext.settings: DispatchDocument.bookedNext { on (default true), withinMin (default 60, 0-240) } — Admin › Dispatch, per zone: 'Driver on a trip can get a booked ride starting within (min)' + on/off. Missing = the defaults.
bookedNext.accept: POST /offers/{offerId}/accept of such an Exclusive while his current trip runs: a booked ride is a held accept (reservation.held true, as a list accept); a live ride is queued as his next trip (TripProjection status accepted, trips.next_after_trip_id = his current trip; no ETA, heading check or waiting until it starts). He stays on his current trip; when it ends (complete, end early, any cancel) the queued trip starts at once (driver_to_pickup clock, ETA). The leave-now check and the late rule still apply to a booked ride. Any other offer while on a trip is still 409 driver_on_trip.
bookedNext.driverApp: Driver app (owner 2026-11-05 'Add on sheet when on trip after accept second trip or if its time to drive to reservation! Notification popup after finish current trip'): during the current trip a next-trip card on the trip sheet: a queued live trip 'Next: {rider} · after this trip' (sv 'Nästa: {rider} · efter den här resan', fr 'Suivante : {rider} · après cette course'), or a held booked ride whose time to drive is near (leaveAt within 30 min, else pickup within 60 min) 'Next: booked ride at {time}' (sv 'Nästa: bokad resa kl. {time}', fr 'Suivante : course réservée à {time}'), with its pickup and 'After this trip, drive to the pickup'. The card goes away when that trip is cancelled. After the current trip ends, the next trip the server started (queued live, or a booked ride whose leave time came) opens on screen automatically with an information popup: title 'Your next trip' (sv 'Din nästa resa', fr 'Votre prochaine course'), body '{rider} is waiting at {pickup}. Drive there now.' / 'Booked ride at {time} · {pickup}. Drive to the pickup now.', and ONE button OK (sv/fr 'OK') that only closes it — it accepts or declines nothing.
bookedNext.liveRides: Live rides: offered as Exclusive under the same 70 % rule in every zone — no zone switch (owner answer 2026-11-05 'any kind of exclusive'; the zone's exclusiveWhileDriving does not gate it). Before v0.18.33 a driver on a trip got no offers at all (owner decision 10).

walletFirst.rule: Owner Q6 ('Switch per ride, starts ON'): CreateTripRequest.walletFirst (default true when missing). true = the rider's wallet balance in the trip's currency pays first: POST /trips reserves walletApplied = min(balance in that currency, fare) and TripProjection.walletApplied / cashToCollect show it from booking on; it is worked out again at boarding (never more than the balance). false = this trip pays nothing from the wallet (walletApplied 0). Another currency's balance is never used (contract.json#walletCurrency).
walletFirst.zone: RiderAppConfig.wallet.usedFirst (Admin › Payments 'Use wallet first', per zone, default true): false = the wallet never pays a trip in that zone, whatever walletFirst says. features.wallet false = the same.
walletFirst.projection: TripProjection.walletFirst: boolean (rider and admin views): the switch the trip was booked with.
walletFirst.riderApp: Rider app: the confirm / payment screen shows a switch 'Use wallet first' (sv 'Använd plånboken först', fr 'Utiliser le portefeuille d'abord'), on by default, only when the wallet has a balance in the trip's currency, with the line 'Your wallet is used first' (sv 'Din plånbok används först', fr 'Votre portefeuille est utilisé en premier').

onTripOffers.settings: CountryRules.onTripOffers { minRouteDonePct (default 70, 0–100), lateFreeCancelMin (default 10, 0–120) } — Admin › Pricing › Tips & limits per country: 'Offers on a trip from (% of the route to the drop-off)' and 'Rider of a next trip may cancel free after (min)'. A zone's own country_rules may set them; else the country's Standard; else the defaults.
onTripOffers.riderApp: A queued live trip shows as accepted with its driver; the driver's ETA counts from the end of his current trip (the server ETA starts when it starts). No rider change needed beyond that.
onTripOffers.chainedEta: Owner Q1 (2026-11-05): the rider of a queued (chained) trip sees the normal 'driver on the way' screen; TripProjection.eta / etaSeconds is the TOTAL: the drive to the driver's current drop-off plus the drive from there to this pickup (straight-line estimates until the trip starts). No extra line.
onTripOffers.offerRecord: Owner Q2: an offer sent while the driver is on a trip (Offer.driverOnTrip) that he declines or lets expire never counts against him: not in his acceptance rate, not in the missed-offers run (autoOffline).
onTripOffers.queuedCancel: Owner Q3: the rider of a queued trip may cancel it free before it starts; the driver gets the notice queuedCancelNotice and his next-trip card goes away.

body.sv: Resenären för din nästa resa avbokade. Avsluta din resa som vanligt.
