onTripOffers.currentCancelled: Owner Q4 ('Not possible to accept new ride and start current, except he have reservation booked and if its time to start reservation so it start if rider cancel! But if rider cancel during on trip so start next trip'): before the current rider is on board no new live offer comes (the 70 % rule). When the current trip ends in any way (complete, end early, any cancel), a queued live trip starts at once; else a held booked ride starts only when its time to drive has come (reservation.leaveAt reached); else the driver is simply free. The driver app opens the started trip with an information popup (OK only).
onTripOffers.lateFreeCancel: Owner Q5: a late current trip keeps the queued trip with this driver. From lateFreeCancelMin minutes (default 10) after accept, the rider of a chained trip may cancel free also after it started (trips.chained).
onTripOffers.serverSafety: Rule 33: the queued trip starts in the same transaction as the driver's release, with its row locked (FOR UPDATE); a driver who still has a current trip is never released.

liveDriversPaging.note: v0.18.34 §65 (Rules plan/FIX-PLAN-RERUN-2026-11-05.md A8/A10, proven cause; owner 2026-11-05 'proven parts now'). Builds on v0.18.33 main. Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5; no migration. Rider and driver apps: no change.
liveDriversPaging.paging: GET /admin/live/drivers takes optional limit (1..1000) and cursor (the nextCursor of the page before). Items are then in driverId order, at most limit, and the answer carries nextCursor (null on the last page). Without limit every matching driver comes back in one answer (older panels), also with nextCursor null. Keyset paging, no server state: any server copy answers any page (rule 33).
liveDriversPaging.total: LiveDriverList.total: how many drivers not offline match the filters (zones, country, map box) over ALL pages, so the panel can show the number before every page has arrived.
liveDriversPaging.counts: zoneSupply and ridersOnline (when no map box is given) always count every matching driver, not only the page.
liveDriversPaging.adminLiveCard: The admin Dashboard's live card, live map and 'Drivers online now' tile are built from GET /admin/live/drivers pages ALONE (limit 500, every page). GET /admin/drivers only adds details (full name, car) when it has loaded; it never decides who is shown. While the first answer is loading the tile shows '…' (Loading); when the live read fails it shows 'Could not load, retrying' (sv 'Kunde inte laddas, försöker igen', fr 'Chargement impossible, nouvel essai'), never 0. Calls for the country the admin left are cancelled when the country changes.

bookedTakeBack.note: v0.18.35 (FIX JOB 4 'take-back', owner Q2 / Q-A / Q-B / fix-plan Q2 / job-4 Q2-Q4 of 2026-11-04, Rules decisions/driver-g15.md). Builds on v0.18.34 main. Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5; no migration (the state lives in trips.reservation and trips.heading_check). §59.
bookedTakeBack.onlyCase: Owner Q2 verbatim: 'System take ride from driver only one case, when have reservation and may can be late more than 5 min but if he soon at pickup like 10 m away so keep it'. Drivers never pay a fee. A LIVE ride is never taken back.
bookedTakeBack.rule: A booked ride a driver holds is taken back when ALL three are true at a check: (a) late = now + drive − scheduledAt > takeBackLateMin minutes (drive = the server's road route from his latest position to the pickup, the same as leaveOnTime); (b) drive > takeBackKeepIfDriveMin minutes (closer = he keeps it); (c) now ≤ scheduledAt − takeBackUntilMinBeforePickup minutes (inside that time he keeps it: still time to find another driver, owner fix-plan Q2). Settings per zone in DriverAppConfig.reservations (defaults 5 / 10 / 15; ranges lateMin 1-60, keepIfDriveMin 0-60, untilMinBeforePickup 0-180).
bookedTakeBack.whenChecked: Before he starts (held, status accepted): with every leave check (every 2 min from 3 h before pickup). After he started (driver_to_pickup): with every ETA tick, but only while the heading check says he has NOT been heading to the pickup for notHeadingMinutes in a row (owner job-4 Q4: 'On every minutes and if he is late so take it from him').
bookedTakeBack.takeBack: In the check's own transaction with the trip row locked (FOR UPDATE): a driver_cancels row reason booked_late_taken_back (counts on his cancel record, NEVER a fee; not a CancelReasonCode on the wire), the driver leaves the ride (cancelled_driver_ids += him), the reservation's per-driver state is cleared (leaveAt, driveSeconds, leaveNotified, atRisk, notStarted), reservation.takenBack { driverId, at } is set (admin TripProjection.reservation.takenBack only, until a new driver takes it), and the ride goes back to the list or to dispatch exactly like a give-back (after dispatchAt: searched at once). The driver gets push + bell reservation_taken_back. A second copy of the same check finds the driver gone and does nothing (idempotent; rule 33).
bookedTakeBack.rider: Owner job-4 Q2: before the driver started driving the rider sees NOTHING (silent swap; the next driver's 'driver found' message is sent as usual). After he started driving the rider sees 'searching for a new driver' (TripProjection.status searching + the existing trip_update driver_changed push) and then the new driver heading to the pickup like a normal trip. Owner Q3: a late driver who KEEPS the ride sends the rider no message.
bookedTakeBack.live: Owner Q-A: live trips are never taken back automatically; pickupWaiting.headingCheck.reassign is read-only and ignored for live trips. Not heading = free rider cancel + the driver's notHeadingNotice every noticeEveryMin minutes.
bookedTakeBack.newDriverState: L6 fix: whenever a booked ride loses its driver (give-back, offline, admin unassign, rider change refused, take-back, driver cancel) the per-driver fields leaveAt, driveSeconds, leaveNotified, atRisk, notStarted are cleared, so the next driver gets his own 'start now' and late-risk notices.
bookedTakeBack.alert: Alert kind booked_taken_back (group dispatch, level important): a taken-back booked ride with no new driver yet; solved when a driver takes it.
bookedTakeBack.admin: Dispatch › Book later › 'Late driver': 'Take back when late more than (min)' 5, 'Keep if the driver is within (min drive)' 10, 'Only until (min before pickup)' 15; 'Not driving to the rider notice' on/off (headingCheck.notice) and 'every (min)' 1; the heading check's 'Take back a live ride' row shown OFF and read-only.
bookedTakeBack.apps: Driver app: shows the push / bell kinds reservation_taken_back and heading_not_to_rider (texts from the server, sv/fr/en built-in fallbacks). Rider app: no new screen (the existing searching / driver-changed flow); contract copy only.

airportQueue.note: v0.18.36 §60 (fix job 9, R27, owner G15 Q5 2026-11-02 'Build it for real' + job 9 answers 2026-11-05, Rules decisions/driver-g15.md). Builds on v0.18.35 main. Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5; server migration 0086. Rider app: no change.
airportQueue.area: AirportQueueArea { areaId, airportZoneId, polygon [[lat, lng], ...] (3-500 points, inside or around the airport), on, leaveGraceMin, offerSeconds, maxQueueOffers, keepPlaceAfterDecline, updatedAt }. One area per airport zone (Zone.kind airport). Off until an admin draws the area and turns it on.
airportQueue.join: A driver joins the queue when the server receives a position of his inside an area that is on while he is online (onlineStatus online, no current trip). His place is the order of joinedAt (then entryId). A driver who dropped a rider at the airport joins at once with his next position (owner job 9 Q5: 'Yes, join at once').
airportQueue.leave: He leaves the queue when: a position of his is outside the area for more than leaveGraceMin minutes in a row; he goes offline or goes online again later (a new online session never keeps the old place); he accepts any trip (queue or not); the area is turned off or removed. The others move up.
airportQueue.dispatch: A trip whose pickup is inside an airport zone with an area that is on: before the normal steps, the first driver in the queue who may get offers (the same filter as any round: online, his zone and category, papers, no open Exclusive, did not decline or miss this trip) gets an Exclusive offer (reasonCode airport-queue) for offerSeconds. A decline or miss goes to the next in the queue, at most maxQueueOffers queue offers per trip; nobody left or all declined -> normal nearest dispatch, unchanged.
airportQueue.decline: Owner job 9 Q4 (2026-11-05): 'Keeps his place'. keepPlaceAfterDecline (default true): a driver who declines or misses a queue offer keeps his place. false = he goes to the back (joinedAt = now).
airportQueue.riders: Owner job 9 Q6: riders see nothing of the queue. Quote, ETA and booking are unchanged.
airportQueue.driverRead: GET /driver/airport-queue -> AirportQueueStatus { status in_queue | not_in_area | off, areaId?, airportZoneId?, position (1 = first), ahead, joinedAt, waitingMin }. The driver app reads it every 20 s while the queue screen or Home is open; there is no sample data.
airportQueue.leftNotice: The driver app shows 'You left the airport queue' when status goes from in_queue to anything else.
airportQueue.adminRead: GET /admin/zones/{zoneId}/queue-area (zones.read) -> AirportQueueArea or 404 not_found; PUT (zones.edit, audited) saves it. GET /admin/airport-queues (zones.read) -> AirportQueueFeed { items [{ areaId, airportZoneId, on, waiting, longestWaitMin, pickupsLastHour }] } for the Dashboard airport card.
airportQueue.serverSafety: Rule 33: the queue is rows in the database (airport_queue_entries, one open row per driver by a unique index); the order is joinedAt in the database, never one server copy's memory. The queue offer is sent in the round's transaction with the trip row locked and the driver row locked NOWAIT and checked again (as every round), so two server copies never send two queue offers for one trip or two Exclusives to one driver.

goOfflineAfterTrips.note: v0.18.37 (owner 2026-11-05, Rules decisions/driver-g15.md + plan/GO-OFFLINE-AFTER-TRIPS-PLAN-2026-11-05.md). Builds on v0.18.36 main. Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5; server migration 0084 (drivers.offline_after_trip, offline_after_trip_at). §61.
goOfflineAfterTrips.owner: Owner verbatim: 'When on trip and want go offline, that mean he is set offline after the trip ends and if he have ongoing trip and another one after so go offline mean after all trips finish'. Booked ride later the same day: 'Keep it, remind him'. Admin switch: 'No switch' (always on).
goOfflineAfterTrips.tap: POST /driver/availability { onlineStatus: offline } while the driver has a current trip (onlineStatus on_trip) answers 200 (before v0.18.37: 409 invalid_transition on_trip). onlineStatus stays on_trip; Driver.offlineAfterTrip = true, Driver.offlineAfterTripSince = the tap time; Driver.version goes up. Tapping again answers the same (idempotent).
goOfflineAfterTrips.undo: POST /driver/availability { onlineStatus: online } while on_trip with offlineAfterTrip true clears it (offlineAfterTrip false, version up). Without the flag it answers the Driver unchanged, as before.
goOfflineAfterTrips.noOffers: From the tap: no new offers of any kind, the on-trip Exclusives after minRouteDonePct (contract.json#afterTestRules, live and booked) included. His open offers are withdrawn at once (the withdraw_driver_offers job, as when going offline). An accept that still reaches the server is refused 409 conflict reason going_offline. Admin sends skip him (he is on a trip).
goOfflineAfterTrips.end: When a trip of his ends (completed, cancelled by anyone, no-show), in the SAME transaction as the trip release with the driver row locked (rule 33, safe with several server copies): a queued live trip (accepted while on the trip, nextAfterTripId) starts and he stays on_trip with the flag; else a held booked ride whose leaveAt has come starts and he stays on_trip with the flag (the server treats a queued live trip like a held booked ride); else he goes offline: onlineStatus offline, offlineReason after_trip, the set_offline notice (data.reason after_trip), offlineAfterTrip false.
goOfflineAfterTrips.bookedLater: A booked ride he holds for later (not yet due) stays his; the normal reminders (reservation_reminder, reservation_go_online) tell him to go online for it.
goOfflineAfterTrips.blocks: A block during the trip (account, car, fleet, expired document) still ends him offline with that reason (it wins over after_trip); the flag is cleared on every way to offline and on going online.
goOfflineAfterTrips.restart: The state is on the server: GET /driver/profile carries offlineAfterTrip, so the driver app shows the banner again after a restart.
goOfflineAfterTrips.admin: No setting. The admin driver view and the live drivers list carry offlineAfterTrip; the admin shows 'Going offline after trips' on an on-trip driver.
goOfflineAfterTrips.driverApp: Go offline during a trip: one POST, keep sending location (the trip goes on), show the banner 'Going offline after this trip' with Undo (POST online). After the last trip the offline card shows reasons.after_trip.
goOfflineAfterTrips.riderApp: No change: the rider's trip goes on as normal; the driver's plan is not shown to riders.

inAppCalls.note: v0.18.38 §62 (fix job 8, Rules plan/FIX-JOBS-8-9-10-PLAN-2026-11-05.md; owner G15 2026-11-05: 'In-app calls only', 'Both rider and driver', "Just 'Call failed'"). Builds on v0.18.34 main. X-Api-Version stays 0.5; additive; server migration 0085 (trip_calls).
inAppCalls.start: POST /trips/{tripId}/call (no body, Idempotency-Key) by the trip's rider or driver → 200 TripCall { tripId, mode:'in_app', callId, ice { servers, ttlSeconds }, ringSeconds, maxCallMin, expiresAt }. The server keeps a trip_calls row (state ringing) and sends call_ringing on the trip stream; the callee's app shows the incoming-call sheet.
inAppCalls.window: Open from driver assignment (tripStatus.driverAssigned) until callWindowAfterTripMin (default 60) minutes after the trip ended as completed (trips.ended_at). Outside it: 409 invalid_transition, reason call_window_closed. A cancelled trip has no window after it. The apps show the call button only inside the window.
inAppCalls.signalling: POST /calls/{callId}/signal { type: offer|answer|ice, sdp?, candidate? } by the call's caller or callee → 202; the server relays it as call_signal on the trip stream (from = the sender's side). Media goes peer to peer (or through the TURN server); the server never sees audio and stores none.
inAppCalls.answer: POST /calls/{callId}/answer by the callee while ringing → 200 CallView (state answered) with ice { servers, ttlSeconds } (the callee's STUN/TURN servers), event call_answered.
inAppCalls.end: POST /calls/{callId}/end { reason: hangup|declined|failed } by either side → 200 CallView (state ended), event call_ended. A second end is answered with the same CallView (idempotent).
inAppCalls.missed: A ringing call not answered after ringSeconds is ended by the server (timer in the database, any server copy runs it): state missed, event call_missed. An answered call is ended at maxCallMin with reason max_length.
inAppCalls.busy: One live call (ringing or answered) per trip: a second POST /trips/{tripId}/call is 409 invalid_transition, reason call_busy, details [the live callId].
inAppCalls.noPhoneNumbers: No call payload (TripCall in_app, CallView, call_* events, admin call log) ever carries a phone number. In mode in_app no number is used at all.
inAppCalls.phoneMode: CountryRules.calls.mode phone + a configured provider (phoneProvider, keys only in the server environment) → TripCall { tripId, mode:'phone', proxyNumber, expiresAt } as before (v0.13.0). Mode phone without a provider falls back to in_app. Owner G15: in-app calls only until a phone company is chosen.
inAppCalls.ice: ice.servers come from the server environment (STUN/TURN URLs; TURN gets time-limited credentials from a shared secret, valid ttlSeconds). No server state: any copy answers (rule 33).

settings.where: Admin › Pricing › Tips & limits per country › Calls (CountryRules.calls of the country standard; a zone's own country_rules may set them), saved with Save tips & limits: Calls on, Mode (In the app / Phone — phone needs a phone company), Call window after the trip (min), Ring time (s), Longest call (min). adminCallRoles stays empty: Admin Call is 'coming soon' until a phone provider is set (G9 Q6).
settings.off: calls.on false → POST /trips/{tripId}/call is 403 forbidden, reason calls_off; the apps hide the call button.

inAppCalls.adminLog: GET /admin/trips/{tripId}/calls (trips.read, trip in the admin's zones) → { items: [CallLogItem { callId, from, to, state, startedAt, answeredAt, endedAt, endedReason, seconds }] }, newest first. Shown in Admin › Trip details › Calls. No audio, no numbers.
inAppCalls.apps: Driver and rider: the call button opens the in-app call screen (Calling…, mute, speaker, end); an incoming call_ringing opens the incoming-call sheet (Answer / Decline). When the call cannot start or the connection fails the screen shows only 'Call failed' (owner G15) and closes. Button hidden outside the window.
inAppCalls.serverSafety: Rule 33: every call state lives in trip_calls (Postgres); start/answer/end lock the row (FOR UPDATE); the ring timeout and the length limit are database timers; signals go out as trip events (database sequence). No call state in one server copy's memory.

noDriverNearby.note: v0.18.39 §63 (fix job N2 + P17 + far rider, fix plan A2 / A11-FR 'Proof: far rider', owner N2 answer 2026-11-05 "'No driver nearby' after 5 min" (admin setting per zone, search continues until the rider cancels) and P17 answers "15 min after pickup past" + admin alert "Yes", boss supervisor night answers (afterSec 300, farReachKm 12), Rules decisions/driver-g15.md). Builds on v0.18.38 main. Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5; no server migration. Driver app: no change.
noDriverNearby.message: DispatchDocument.noDriverNearby { on (default true), afterSec (default 300, 60-1800), message (default 'No driver nearby right now. We keep searching for you.') }, per zone (Admin › Dispatch). A live ride still without a driver afterSec seconds after its search started shows the rider TripProjection.searchStep { kind no_driver_nearby, message } ONCE (one search step, id nd, fired once per search). The search keeps going. Booked rides never get it (they have P17).
noDriverNearby.riderAnswer: The rider app shows the message with two buttons: Keep waiting (POST /trips/{tripId}/keep-waiting { answer: wait }: nothing else changes, the search goes on) and Cancel free (answer stop: the normal rider cancel, free because no driver has accepted). keep-waiting accepts searchStep.kind keep_waiting or no_driver_nearby, once per step. No answer: the search goes on.
noDriverNearby.liveNoEnd: Owner N2 'search keeps going until the rider cancels': a LIVE ride's search has no end time any more. radius.maxWaitMin and the busy step no longer end it (busy is shown as a message only, never after no_driver_nearby; keep_waiting is not shown after no_driver_nearby, which already asks). The trip leaves the search only when a driver accepts, the rider cancels, or an admin acts. A zone with no published dispatch rules still ends after 10 min (nobody can be dispatched). Supersedes, for live rides, the 'search end' and 'busy: the search ends' rules of contract.json#dispatch.rules.
noDriverNearby.farReach: DispatchDocument.limits.farReachKm (default 12, > 0 and <= 50, road km like every step, roadFactor 1.25), per zone (Admin › Dispatch). Used only once the steps are used up (repeat rounds) and NOBODY NEW is inside the widest step: no free driver in reach, or every one in reach already declined or let an offer of this trip run out. Then the search adds ONE extra step at farReachKm (radius.steps, radar.steps and exclusive.steps each get farReachKm as their widest value; limits.maxPickupKm does not cap it; maxPickupEtaMin still does) and its repeat rounds go on at that reach until the end of the search. farReachKm at or below the widest step (or limits.maxPickupKm) = off. Neighbour zones are unchanged (neighbours.on).
noDriverNearby.reaskLimit: Stop re-asking one busy driver forever: DispatchDocument.reaskLimit (default 2, 1-5, per zone, Admin › Dispatch; boss 1 for the owner 2026-11-05): a driver who declined or let run out that many offers of this trip in this search (Radar or Exclusive) is not asked again in this search; withdrawn offers do not count; a new search (driver cancel, rider raise) starts the count again. Owner decisions 23 / Q1 (a decliner may see the trip again) still hold: once more, not forever.
noDriverNearby.bookedStop: P17 (owner 'Q-P17 15 min after pickup past'): a booked ride with no driver (requested, searching or offered) noDriverStopAfterMin minutes after its pickup time (DriverAppConfig.reservations.noDriverStopAfterMin, default 15, 1-240, per zone, Admin › Dispatch › Book later) is ended by the server: open offers withdrawn, system expire (status expired, ended_by_command expire), TripProjection.reservation.noDriverFound true, searchStep { kind no_driver_found, message 'No driver was found for your booked ride. You pay nothing.' }. No fee. Nothing is charged at booking today: the server takes cash only (server src/trips/finish.ts SERVER_PAYMENT_METHODS = [cash]; POST /trips refuses card with payment_method_coming_soon), and a wallet part is only reserved until boarding, so there is nothing to refund. When card payments start, the free-cancel refund of contract.json#bookLater.card applies to this end too. The rider gets push reservation_no_driver_found. Replaces 'the ride never expires by itself' of contract.json#bookLater.noDriver (BL-Q7) after noDriverStopAfterMin.
noDriverNearby.alerts: Admin alerts (group dispatch, level important): no_driver_nearby at the same moment the rider is shown no_driver_nearby (solved when a driver takes it or the ride ends); booked_no_driver_ended when P17 ends a booked ride (shown 24 h, or until done). Admin › Trips: a searching live trip whose searchStep.kind is no_driver_nearby carries the mark 'No driver in reach'.
noDriverNearby.admin: Admin › Dispatch (per zone): 'Ask one driver at most (offers)' (reaskLimit, 1-5, default 2); 'No driver nearby' on/off, 'after (min)' (afterSec / 60, 1-30) and the message; 'Far reach (km)' (limits.farReachKm). Admin › Dispatch › Book later: 'Stop a booked ride with no driver after pickup + (min)' (noDriverStopAfterMin). The 'Max wait' and 'busy' rows say they end booked rides' search rounds only (live rides keep searching).
noDriverNearby.driver: Driver app: no change. A far offer already shows its long pickup distance (pickupMeters) and pickup pay.
noDriverNearby.serverSafety: Rule 33 (several server copies): the no_driver_nearby step and the P17 stop are durable timers in the database (search_step nd, resv_no_driver_stop), handled with the trip row locked (NOWAIT for dispatch timers); fired steps and the far state (SearchState.far) live in the searches row under that lock; the decline / run-out count is read from the offers table. No server copy keeps any of it in memory.

routeVia.note: v0.18.41 §66 (Rules plan/FIX-PLAN-RERUN-2026-11-05.md A14, proven cause; boss Decision 8). Builds on v0.18.39 main. Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5; no migration; stateless (rule 33).
routeVia.request: POST /routes takes optional via: up to 10 LatLng (the trip's stops, in order; the zone's maxStops is 0-10). The server routes [from, ...via, to] with the same router as POST /quotes, so the drawn line and the price follow the same route. RoadRoute then covers every leg; distanceMeters and durationSeconds are the whole route.
routeVia.fallback: No road route: the answer is the straight line through every point, [from, ...via, to], never from -> to when there are stops.
routeVia.apps: Rider: Select ride and Finding drivers draw the road line through every stop (one road leg per pair via the routing seam); a leg without road is drawn straight through the stop and the map shows 'Approximate route'. The quote's distanceMeters hint is the straight distance via the stops. Driver app and admin panel: their maps already draw through the stops (checked, no change).

blockedPairs.note: v0.18.43 §64 (fix job 10, Rules plan/FIX-JOBS-8-9-10-PLAN-2026-11-05.md; owner G16 Q16-4 and G15 2026-11-05: block told → 'Never told', undo own block → 'No, only Support'). Builds on v0.18.41 main. X-Api-Version stays 0.5; additive; server migration 0087 (blocked_pairs).
blockedPairs.pair: BlockedPair { pairId, riderId, driverId, by: admin|rider|driver, reason?, tripId?, at, adminId? }: this rider and this driver are never matched again. One active pair per rider + driver (a second block of the same pair answers the pair that exists).
blockedPairs.dispatch: A blocked pair is never offered: no Exclusive, no Radar, no airport-queue offer, no admin money offer, no on-trip next trip, and the booked ride is not listed to that driver in Scheduled rides nor claimable by him. The search goes on with the other drivers exactly as if that driver were not there; with nobody else it goes on as 'no driver' (no special step, no message).
blockedPairs.rating: POST /trips/{tripId}/rating may carry dontMatchAgain: true (rider and driver). Allowed only with stars ≤ CountryRules.dontMatchAgain.atStars (default 1) while dontMatchAgain.on (default true); otherwise 400 invalid_body, reason dont_match_not_allowed, and nothing is saved. With it the server writes the pair (by = the rater) in the same transaction as the rating. The answer is the same Rating as without it.
blockedPairs.neverTold: The other side is never told (owner 'Never told'): no event, push, notice, field or count shows a block to the rider or driver who was blocked; the trip, offer and profile projections are unchanged. Only admins see pairs.
blockedPairs.undo: Only Support undoes a pair (owner 'No, only Support'): DELETE /admin/blocked-pairs/{pairId} (riders.block, audit blocked_pair.remove). The apps have no undo and no list.
blockedPairs.admin: POST /admin/trips/{tripId}/block-pair { reason? } (riders.block, Idempotency-Key, audit blocked_pair.add) blocks the trip's rider and driver (by admin); 409 invalid_transition, reason no_driver, when the trip has no driver. GET /admin/blocked-pairs?riderId=|driverId= (riders.read) lists the active pairs of one person, newest first. Admin › Trips › trip page: Block this pair; Admin › Rider and Admin › Driver pages: Blocked pairs with Undo.

settings.where: CountryRules.dontMatchAgain { on, atStars } per country (Admin › Pricing › Tips & limits › Don't match again). The server serves the same block as RiderAppConfig.dontMatchAgain and DriverAppConfig.dontMatchAgain (GET /rider/config, /driver/config) so both apps show the tick only when it is allowed.

apps.tick: Both rating screens show one tick under the stars only while the chosen stars ≤ atStars and on: rider 'Don't match me with this driver again', driver 'Don't match me with this rider again'. Unticked by default; raising the stars above atStars clears it. After sending nothing else changes on screen.

blockedPairs.riderLevels: The rider app shows the riderModeration levels (v0.18.29): warning = a banner 'Warning from Movera' with the reason on Home (GET /rider/profile Rider.moderation); paused = a full screen 'Your account is paused' with the reason and the end date (moderation.until), Contact support and Sign out; banned = the same screen 'Your account is blocked' without a date. The screen opens from Rider.moderation and from any 403 account_suspended (its projection). The driver app shows nothing new.
blockedPairs.rule33: State lives only in blocked_pairs (partial unique index on rider_id + driver_id where removed_at is null; inserts are ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); every dispatch path reads it in the same query round, so any server copy gives the same answer.

sameAddress.note: v0.18.44 §67 (Rules plan/FIX-PLAN-RERUN-2026-11-05.md 'Proof: same-address booking', proven cause; boss answers decisions/driver-g15.md 2026-11-05; boss Decisions 10 and 12; owner Q9 v0.18.30 'Warn him but can accept booking' overrides the boss 300 m default, so the refusal is OFF by default). Builds on v0.18.43 main (renumbered from 0.18.44, Decision 13). Additive; X-Api-Version stays 0.5; no migration (minTripMeters lives in the zone's pricing document JSON); stateless (rule 33).
sameAddress.geocode: POST /locations/geocode: an app resolving a picked suggestion sends its placeId (and the text as query). The server resolves by placeId and answers name, the place's own name (e.g. 'Solna Centrum'), next to address (the provider's formatted street address). name is absent for a typed address with no placeId.
sameAddress.label: The trip's pickup/dropoff/stop address is the label the rider chose: the suggestion's title + ', ' + subtitle (or the geocode name when the suggestion had no title). The app never replaces a chosen label by the geocode address; address only fills a label that is missing. The driver app and the admin panel show that same trip address text (no change of field).

minTripMeters.where: pricing document (zone pricing, admin Pricing page): minTripMeters, integer metres; missing = default 0 (off, owner Q9: warn but can book); an admin turns it on per zone
minTripMeters.measure: straight line (haversine) pickup -> drop-off; a trip with one or more stops is not checked (a round trip through a stop is a real trip)

sameAddress.refuse: POST /quotes and POST /trips refuse a drop-off closer than minTripMeters to the pickup: 400 invalid_request, reason dropoff_too_close, details ['meters=<n>', 'limitMeters=<m>']. /trips re-checks with the zone's live value (the admin may have raised it since the quote). The older samePointWarnMeters warning (v0.18.30) still applies above the limit. Off by default (owner Q9).

riderText.en: Drop-off is too close to pickup
riderText.fr: Le point de dépose est trop proche du point de prise en charge

sameAddress.apps: Rider: keeps the chosen name, sends placeId, and on dropoff_too_close shows riderText and stays on the destination step. Driver: shows the trip's address (now the chosen name) on the offer and trip screens. Admin: the minTripMeters setting (0-5000 m, default 0 = off) on the zone pricing page.
